He soon finds out that his abilities are above average—in fact, his new skills are so overpowered that they’re like cheats. On top of that, his cat companion turns out to be a half-tiger girl! One day, Yuzuru Takasegawa — a first-year high school student — is urged by his grandfather to go on an arranged marriage meeting, insisting that he wants to see his great-grandson before he dies.

And on the day of matchmaking, it was Arisa Yukishiro, a beautiful girl with reputation at school, shows up on the scene.

Upon hearing her story, it seems she was also reluctantly made to go on matchmaking. Therefore, the two of them try to prevent themselves from further marriage proposals with their false “engagement”.

And so, as they play the role of fake lovers, they find themselves in love with each other and become real lovers.

title.native: ちょっと今から仕事やめてくる

127066.description: Somewhere within a family of three, lived four cute pets: three balls of purrs and a little puppy. Not a moment goes by without something interesting happening with these four adorable pets each and every day...

title.romaji: Wo Zhishi Yi Zhi Xiao Maomi

title.romaji: Ora, Yomekko sa Iku da!: Cosplay JK no Himitsu no Aijou x Yankee JK no Ijou na Aijou

127070.description:
For years, Hibiki's best friend Haruma pulled jokes on him. All that time, Hibiki secretly crushed on Haruma without hope. When Haruma suggests to Hibiki that they start dating, is Haruma just playing with his feelings? Or does Hibiki actually have a chance?

(Source: Futekiya)

title.english: I Like You Even if you Tease Me
title.native: 遊ばれてても君がすき

127072.description: Selena, the top star that had the entire world's attention, was suddenly warped to Northern Duke's land during an accident while filming.Kalcion, the Northern Duke that saved her from the infernal beasts, offers Selena a chance to go back home in return for collecting information in various social circles by pretending to be his lover. Selena quickly accepts Kalcion's offer, but... There was a critical problem. The Northern Duke's acting skills are horrible! And thus the contractual relationship between the two started. Will Kalcion's acting skill improve first, or will he start to have true feelings for Selena instead?
synonyms: I Will Seduce the Northern Duke

127073.description: A one-shot focusing on Sister Krone and her past.

title.english: The Promised Neverland: Special Side Story - Seeking the Sky of Freedom
title.native: 約束のネバーランド 特別番外編 自由の空を求めて
title.romaji: Yakusoku no Neverland: Tokubetsu Bangai-hen - Jijyuu no Sora wo Motomete

127075.description:
Wang Jian's younger sister is seriously ill but they can't afford her treatment. In desperation, Wang Jian unexpectedly obtains an app called Immortal Realm Trading System, which not only saves his sister's life but also grants him multiple super abilities. However, as time passes, Wang Jian discovers that he is not just some ordinary guy with cheat abilities.

(Source: WebComics)

127076.description:
Geum Aji doesn’t want to be secretary to young, handsome CEO Cha Do-hwan. She’s been forced into the job by her uncle, and her parents have explicitly forbidden her from resigning voluntarily. Meanwhile, Do-hwan doesn’t want quirky, honest Geum Aji as his secretary, but he has his own reasons for not being able to fire her. Things get even more complicated when they have a drunken one night stand on Aji’s first day at work. Aji wants to be fired. Do-hwan wants her to resign. Who will be the one to give in first? Or will they give in to an entirely different kind of desire?

(Source: Lezhin US)

127077.description:
Ordinary office worker Anna is suddenly reincarnated into an 18+ otome game–but as the villainess! Now in the role of Annelie, she’s not interested in hot and steamy fun, she’s desperate to escape. Except her husband, the handsome and secretly sadistic Prince Lienhard, isn’t letting her go so easily. Instead, he’s pressing her to reenact their wedding night to help her regain Annelie’s memories! Will she be able to resist his touch or is she destined to bend to his every whim?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

127078.description: In the women's prison, there is a beauty salon that is open to the general public. If you make an appointment, a prisoner will cut your hair for you. The minds of the customers are filled with anxiety about the crime the hairdresser has committed, but the blue sky painted on the walls of the salon always manage to calm them down. Spending time with the hairdresser is enjoyable, but why did she become a criminal in the first place?
synonyms: Deep Sky - La Gabbia delle Nuvole

127079.description:
On his way home from work, the 26 year old salaryman, Kawakita Osamu, encounters an alien named Lilin. She and her species plan on invading the earth but she ended up getting stranded on this planet. Can Osamu raise her to become a kind-hearted kid before her species eradicates humanity in five years?

Note: Includes 3 extra chapters.

title.native: 人類を滅亡させてはいけません
title.romaji: Jinrui wo Metsubou sasete wa Ikemasen

127081.description:
A bad boy on the outside with a kind heart underneath. A rich and cold genius with family issues. Two opposite worlds collide and form a bond that lasts. “Untouchable” shows high school love can be much more than just meets the eyes.

(Source: INKR)

127082.description:
Minhee lost her parents in a car accident at the age of 12. After the accident, Minhee is raised by the family of her male friend, Pilho, but suffers torment and discrimination. It's almost as if at this point, Pilho is like her real family. However, for Pilho, Minhee is not family. Little by little, he starts to see her as more than just a friend, but what happens when the new next door neighbor, an older guy, catches Minhee's eye? What if this guy, Kang Muyeol, is actually the new teacher at Minhee's school?!

Note: Includes 14 extra chapters.

127083.description:
College student Doori’s greatest passion is playing Battle Legend, an FPS Battle Royale game. He's been grinding to level up for years and his technical game is... good! Determined to win an inter-collegiate Battle Legend Co-Op tournament, Doori finds the perfect partner in Noah, an incoming freshman. Noah is just... a natural. Elegant, smooth, and they move together so well. YES! Noah agrees to team up with Doori, but only in exchange for... kisses~!

(Source: Tapas)

127084.description:
In my real life, I was happy simping and fawning over Abel Louvremont, the main character of my favorite book ‘Persona.’ But after a fateful car accident, I woke up in ‘Persona,’ but when Abel is still a precious child. Now, as Aisha Heathcliff, I can simp the adorable Abel up close, squee!! I’ll do anything I can to make sure he gets what he needs! And, somehow, that means I’m engaged to... his dad?!

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes 15 extra chapters.

127085.description:
A noble man in silk clothing appears in front of the fifteen year old Eun Hong, who is about to be sold off to the Courtesan house due to her father's debts. He was the same man who occasionally bought the straw shoes that Eun Hong sold at the market. After coming across him at the courtesan house, Eun Hong is sold off to him for a handsome sum of five hundred taels...

Choi Taewoong, the 21 year old leader of the Fire Dragon Trade business, the largest business in Joseon. He buys and sells everything with money, but will he be able to buy a bride with money as well?

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

127086.description:
Beautiful, smart, and athletic, Nami-san is the perfect girl at school. But when she's with her boyfriend Kase-kun, Nami turns into a clumsy wreck. Just the sound of his voice or his slight touch gets her all flustered. Nami wishes she could spend more time with Kase-kun, but she just can't be together with him!

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

title.native: 君と一緒じゃままならない
title.romaji: Kimi to Issho ja Mama Naranai

127087.description:
Former rising star, current no-name actor Jang Seung-Min’s lucked out. Not only has he nabbed a role in a TV show, but he’s also getting to work with the biggest star in the country, Ha Hyeon-Je. Charismatic, handsome, but also a little bit of a jerk, Hyeon-Je has a magnetic presence that draws everyone in. Before Seung-Min knows it, he’s become yet another Ha Hyeon-Je fanboy. Seung-Min's satisfied with keeping a safe distance between himself and Hyeon-Je, but... Why is Hyeon-Je so interested in Seung-Min? More importantly, what does "the incident" that happened 7 years ago have to do with anything?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Notes: Includes five extra chapters.

127088.description:
For Kile, it’s just a normal day at work until Lou walks in. Tall, blond and dashing, he’s not the type of guy that goes unnoticed. Lou eventually sweet-talks Kile back to his place… and that’s when the bomb drops. “Your twin brother is dead. Soon, you will become an esper.” At those words, Kile’s ordinary life is turned upside down. As the telekinetic powers begin to manifest, his body is overtaken by a fever. Wracked with pain, he finds the only thing that soothes him is Lou’s touch… Yet so much remains unexplained. What does Lou want? And what was his relationship with Ray, Kile’s twin brother?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Chapter count includes 6 extras.

127089.description:
The new boy group sensation “Poison” is out to conquer the K-Pop scene with their buff bodies and sexy charm. With a successful debut and thousands of eager fans, everything seems to be going well…or is it? As the group’s prim and proper leader, Sihyun should be dreaming of chart domination. But instead, his dreams are filled with fantasies about his groupmate, the sullen and mysterious Seong-eun. As the two spend more and more time together, they get caught up in a whirlwind of muddled passion and sweaty tension, both on and off the stage. Will they manage to keep things together? And will those dreams be fulfilled?

(Source: Lezhin)

Chapter count includes three special episodes and a prologue

127091.description: Hiro’s childhood friend Chiwa is like a little sister to him. Instead of a promise to marry each other, they made a promise with a toy choker to keep a relation like a dog and its master. When Chiwa left with her mother to England, she vowed to return to Japan one day and be in the same class in school one day. A few years later, she finds out that her mother will be remarrying his father. However, if she becomes his true imouto, does that mean that she can’t marry him anymore!? She hurries back to Japan and asks him if he remembers their promise. She offers to become her oniichan’s pet and wants him to love her a lot.

127092.description:
After 20 years of misery, Wu You thought he was going to live his life in a muddle until he found the failed half-immortal Shenyuzi in a garbage can on a stormy day. After which his fate was changed forever! Let’s see how a loser inherits an immortal body, has beauties as his companions, subdues demons, owns hundreds of billions of dollars, and starts down the path of a counterattack!

(Source: WeComics)

127093.description:
A collection of one shots:

1. Nakenai Hime to Usotsuki Ouji (泣けない姫と嘘つき王子)
2. Konkatsu Hime to 16-sai no Ouji (婚活姫と16歳の王子)
3. Seifuku Hime to Dokusetsu Ouji (制服姫と毒舌王子)
4. Kakin Hime to 3-jigen Ouji (課金姫と3次元王子)
5. Unmei Janai Hito (運命じゃない人)

127094.description: This is a world where humans, demons and mysterious beasts coexist. Humans cultivate mysterious qi. Demons cultivate corporeal bodies. Mysterious beasts cultivate soul perception. A legend says that in the middle of an endless rainforest, there are extremely powerful existences; they are called demon kings. Some demon kings have a tyrannical corporeal body, some are experts in illusions. Some demon kings are proficient in magic, some can even move mountains. Some demon kings are able to sense things thousands of miles away. These demon kings rarely appear in the human world. Even if they emerge in the human world, they would reincarnate in human form; assimilating with mankind while seeking to breakthrough realms...

127095.description:
Introducing the defiance of natural order through force! For countless years, immortals have fallen into their doom. On the other hand, Young Master Leng Feng, a worthless person who committed suicide on Xuan Tian continent suddenly awoke as an Almighty God. From then on, an Almighty god has resurrected. All powers were reshuffled, and the glory Xuan Tian continent will rise again!

(Source: AC.QQ, translated)

127096.description:
This sequel occurs 10 years after the original Panlong.

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

127097.description:
The continent of Long Mai is home to thousands of sects where cultivation is the way of life. The strong conquer everything while the weak live like ants. Young Chen Feng was born with a weak energy core, making him unable to cultivate. Nevertheless, he ignores the countless sneers directed at him. Incidentally, he comes across mysterious dragon blood that opens up a new chapter of his life. He finds himself in the embrace of charming fox spirits, a prideful empress, a magical enchantress, and even a deity princess. With unparalleled martial techniques that have manifested from the most potent martial spirit, he stares down from the highest heavens, accompanied by many beauties.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

127098.description:
Zhao Dongting was betrayed and killed by his lover, but he came back to life in Dynasty Song South and become emperor. He stepped on the dead sea and set foot on the throne, and turned the madness to the side, and helped to build the kingdom, and become the legend of the supreme emperor!

(Source: AC.QQ, translated)

127101.description:
Once a cancer patient, Inhan Kang starts a new life as the great warrior Karma after falling through a mana hole.

(Source: Toomics)

127102.description:
After learning 15 miserable years of his life as a failed gamer was one long nightmare, Lee Eojin is glad to be a newbie again. Vowing not to repeat the same mistakes, Eojin starts anew as the hotshot, Old-timer. He’s conquering monsters, getting sweet gear, and making enough dough to set himself up for life. Loved by fans and hated by foes, both old and new, will Eojin break the game and triumph, or will the game break him once again?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: มือใหม่พันธุ์เก๋า

127103.description:
Beautiful girls from all over the world gather up to live... in a space station? A comedic and tear-jerking story that accurately depicts the struggles of space!

(Source: Cycomi, translated)

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

127104.description: Koutarou, a spry young go-getter from Hokkaido, moves to Tokyo to get involved with the salesman business. Unfortunately for him, it’s slim pickings as he becomes intertwined with the lives of several other salespeople and scammers in his attempt to make money as cheap and as quick as possible.

127107.description: The manga takes place in a world where the use of Super Robots is questioned. Koji is a former pilot with his companions faced with both personal and outer conflicts. They were once heroes but peace was achieved, bringing their robot's use into question. Can this peace even last and can it even lead to true peace...?

title.native: マジンガーZ　インターバルピース

127108.description:
Yi-Hyeok and In-Seo have been friends for their entire lives. It’s something they take for granted. Just like the sky is blue and water is wet, the two of them are lifelong buddies. Or, well, that’s what they think right up until the moment In-Seo kisses Yi-Hyeok as a joke that turns into something more, sparking a whole new scorchingly hot relationship between them. It might be pretty funny, really steamy, and a little strange...but they’re still friends. Right? …Right?!

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 66 extra chapters.

127109.description:
For Haesoo, the idea of a demanding, sexually aggressive “queen” has always felt more appealing than being “king” himself. But when he thinks he’s finally met someone who can turn that dream into reality, he discovers that it’s not a woman who’s waiting to dominate him but another guy… Is this the sexual fantasy that Haesoo has always been after? Can Haesoo handle being pushed far beyond his limits? Check out the newest BL comic from the author of “An Innocent Sin” and “Temptress”!

(Source: Lezhin)

127110.description:
Aria, a wild huntress who spent her entire life in the forest, encounters a handsome stranger in her cabin. Who is this intruder and where did he come from? What began as curiosity turns into attention, friendship, and more.
Gradually learning the true identity of this stranger, she enters a whole new world she never knew existed. Aria is already the best huntress in town, but will she able to capture the heart of her new prey? What adventures await in this new world of hers?

(Source: Pocket Comics)

title.english: The Huntress and Her Love Prey

127111.description:
A salacious bondage sesh with the boss counts as overtime, right? Seungwon's first job lands herself in the lap of video game mastermind, Mimi Kim. Mimi "reluctantly" spins a web of lust, while coy Seungwon discovers her inner dominatrix. It's a titillating dance of kinks and toys, all for the sake of saving the company and the future of game development. Throw in a little blackmail and you've got the fantasy that HR reports are made of.

(Source: Tapas)

127112.description:
They thought they were inseparable. A terrible tragedy kept them apart. Forever? Unhappiness always strikes when you least expect it. And when it leaves a gaping void in the heart, how can we continue to live as if nothing had happened?

(Source: Pocket Comics)

127113.description:
Gitaek always dreamed of being in a relationship with someone who’s his ideal preference: caring, thoughtful and has a good body. After being absent for a while, he goes to his club’s meeting room and finds a new student—Jungwoo—who fits this preference and ends up confessing to Jungwoo while he’s drunk. Jungwoo is touched and a little flustered by the first confession he has ever received but, while getting to know each other, Jungwoo finds out that Gitaek’s drinking habit is confessing…

Can the two have a happy ending after an unintended push and pull?

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Note: Includes ten extra chapters.

127116.description:
Chiaki Haruno isn't happy. He thought he got into this company as a literary editor, but it turns out he's going to be editing manga! To make matters worse, he accidentally confides in Yuzuru Houjou, the manga artist he's supposed to work with, and tells him how he's using Yuzuru's manga as a stepping stone to get transferred! Now Chiaki has to beg Yuzuru to keep working with him, and Yuzuru's not letting him off easy. This is a seductive tale of a handsome manga artist and his cute editor that's bound to make your mouth water!

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: The Manga Artist's Pen and the Company Ink

127117.description:
A miserable female lead meets a notable bossy male lead. She is ill-fated and constantly bullied and framed by others, even to an extent that she loses her father... Until she encounters him on a rainy night. Is it a fortuity or a destined reunion?

(Source: Webcomics)
synonyms: Guide to a Male God Chasing His Wife

127118.description:
That night, the ex-leader of a gang and a chef-in-training, Tetsuji, was driven to an unexpected situation. It happened because of a trivial incident… he had saved an omega, Kaneda who was in trouble. For Tetsuji, it's just an action on a whim but it's another story for Kaneda. Even though he's unable to accept Kaneda's feelings, he still thinks that he's cute. But one night, when the Kaneda got his heat while walking home, the alpha came to the rescue.

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

127119.description: One night, Hiyama, a police officer working in a small neighborhood police station, provides counselling for a college student, Okazaki, who had attempted to flash his body at people. Hiyama, unable to leave the naive Okazaki alone, who only resorted to what he did as he was unable to properly vent out his peculiar fetish, called out to Okazaki asking, "If you're fine with me, shall I keep you company?" And from then on, the days of their secret meetings kept from everyone in a unrecognized hotel began...?!

127120.description:
38-year-old businessman Masami has the best boyfriend in the world. Tora's tall, built, and super hot! More than anything, he's incredibly kind. It's no wonder Masami relies on him so much. He even has four other boyfriends besides Tora, but Tora doesn't seem to mind. He always welcomes Masami with a warm smile and a gentle kiss. But, what if Tora has other guys on the side, too...? Is that why he's so "understanding" about Masami's other lovers?

(Source: Renta!)

127121.description: Yukako, a housewife tired of the pressure put upon her by the people in her life, has an unexpected reunion with a woman from her past. This meeting makes Yukako yearn for the touch of another woman again as she tries to keep her affair a secret from her husband.

127122.description:
1946 Choseon (Korea). Beautiful and brilliant Dr. Maria Arden returns to the country of her birth as the medical advisor to the U.S. Army—a stranger in an unfamiliar land ravaged by wars and corruption. There, she meets Dr. Kyeongju Lee, an alluring, mysterious woman shunned by society. Their innocent flirtations turn into a heated, forbidden love affair, as an illegal trade in opium threatens Choseon’s fragile stability. Two outsiders drawn helplessly to each other, but… everything was a lie.

(Source: Tapas)

127136.description:
Meet Youko Yamamoto—a cat-eyed, 15-year-old girl in the late 20th century with a love for videogames and Pocky. Because of her exceptional talent with arcade shooters, she's been recruited by Lawson to travel a thousand years into the future to pilot the prototype ship TA-29. Together with Ayano Elizabeth Hakuhouin, Madoka Midou and Momiji Kagariya, Youko leads the Terran team against Rouge and Ness' infamous Red Snappers in this epic space adventure.

(Source: Anime News Network)

127137.description:
In an era of intensifying terrorist attacks and ethnic conflicts, militarized mecha-armor came into the widespread use. As organized crime becomes increasingly violent and sophisticated, a new "Special Investigation Department" is established by the Metropolitan Police, headed by a former Foreign Ministry person, Junichiro Okitsu. The Special Investigation Department operates the "Ryu-Kibo", a state-of-the-art mecha-armor, and hires three mercenaries as its crew, who are shunned as "traitors" by the rest of the police organization. The members of the Special Investigation Department will have to confront a heinous crime that will shake Japan and the rest of the world!

(Source: Yanmaga, translated)

127138.description: Totomi was abandonned by her parents and has to live with his uncle Kaname since her childhood. In love with each other they will end up in an incestious relationship while knowing that this won't last forever. When Tomomi has to meet Shinji, her fiancé, they see the opportunity to end their relationship, but the link that unites them is much stronger than social conventions

127139.description: It's a yuri comic about an OL and her boss living together. Official doujin for Nikurashii Hodo Aishiteru.

127140.description:
Su Keke, a quick learner who devotes to study, encountered a fortune teller on her way home and was transformed into someone with enchantment. As a result, her life changed drastically. All the boys became her fans and she received various confessions every single day, which greatly impeded her study! All those who try to stop me from studying, go to hell!! Don't love me, or die!!

(Source: Webcomics)

127141.description:
An unprecedentedly brilliant cultivator, sabotaged and killed one night, was somehow reborn into a plane of a lower dimension as a loser everyone bullied. Using the cultivation experience of his previous lifetime, he became a force to be reckoned with and embarked on the journey of revenge…

(Source: WebComics)

127142.description:
His father, who abandoned him 11 years ago, bequeathed him with an apartment. But it turns out he was to share it with his stepsister. Find out who's going to get on top in this thrilling romance!

(Source: TOPTOON+)

A man is the target of a certain kunoichi's mission, and a lot of blood was spilled to learn this.

However, it's said that a kunoichi takes some "liberties" with the mission... Or are those part of the mission too?

Woojin is so good with animals you could call him human catnip!
But, thanks to his gloomy appearance and shy personality, he has a hard time connecting with other people.
On the opposite end of the spectrum is Sangyoon, the kind, bright and handsome owner of an animal cafe.
He meets Woojin by chance and is enthralled by the way he immediately bonds with animals.
He ends up inviting Woojin to come work for him at the cafe.

Born as the thirteenth prince, Noah was originally in a position removed from the imperial succession, so he freely passed his time in the fief granted to him.

However, the Crown Prince died before the Emperor. The imperial succession would be fairly contested among the remaining princes. Noah, being the strongest despite living freely, overwhelmed the other princes and eventually became the Emperor with the most power in the world.

127168.description:
Once hailed as a Sage, he sought peace—not glory. At the end of a long life filled with power and prestige, a man once known as the Sage activated a reincarnation spell, hoping for nothing more than a quiet life in a new era. But when he awakens in a time where magic is no longer valued, he's cast aside as worthless and abandoned in the Forest of Monsters... as a newborn.

Left to die, he's miraculously saved by a kind-hearted goblin who raises him as her own. Given the name Belamus, the former Sage grows up in a monster village, far from the human world that rejected him.

Determined to repay the goblin who took him in, Belamus uses the wisdom of his past life to help the village thrive.

Now begins the tale of a once-great Sage rebuilding a nation—for monsters. The strongest kindom rises not for mankind, but for those they fear.

(Source: Hanashi Media)

Qin Ze only wanted to be a quiet handsome man, but unfortunately he was transformed into a cross-dresser by his sister who spares no effort to entrap him! The night before Hui-Un is to start an odd new job for Geon-Ju, he comes across a strange BL novel where the main characters have their names. 127200.description:
Our protagonist has been reincarnated into the world of an otome game as the villainess "Mariabell Tempest", a noble lady with a dreadful personality. Whenever the game's heroine reaches a happy ending, Mariabell would face a bad ending involving her being disgraced, going missing, or even dying. On top of that, the enabled ‘auto-mode’ is preventing Mariabell from choosing her own decisions however and whenever she wants. But on the 6th loop of the game, the the "auto-mode" causing her inevitable fate finally deactivates! Now, in order to survive and live peacefully, Mariabell will have to take advantage of her knowledge and experience from the past five loops! The manga version of the popular fantasy-otome game reincarnation novel is finally here!

(Source: MANGA UP!)

They’re filled with happiness everyday~ ★ Their lovey-dovey newlywed life will be debuting with lots of extras! Please be soothed by these warm and flirty stories. ♪

127207.description:
At the spring season in college sophomore, Kotaro should be enjoying his youth, freedom and his campus life. But without a girlfriend or any close friends, his life has been rather unspectacular. One day, Miyako, Kotaro's female friend from his childhood asks him to pretend to be her boyfriend so that she can blow off a boy, Aoi who is making an unwanted move to her. Before Kotaro can make a decision, he accidentally meets Aoi and they happen to have teas together. It looks that Kotaro successes in making Aoi give up Miyako, but Aoi easily spots his lie and says, "Instead of giving up her, get along with me". He takes Kotaro into the bathroom of the college, saying that he can teach many things...

A philanderer boy with a modest boy who wants to spend a quiet life... A pure love story, stepping up awkwardly from a normal friendship.

(Source: Takeshobo)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

127208.description:
It is said that the god who protects the house will bring good fortune to the people who live there...
Suganami Tao, who was only interested in money, is introduced to a shady short-term job with a shady income by a senior colleague. He is to live in an old mansion in the countryside and make offerings to the "God" enshrined in the inner sanctum... The money is enough to entice Tao to apply, but there is a mysterious girl in the old house... A story of God and people living in a warm and happy season.

127210.description:
Sumire wants to experience romance...but will she get the chance, when her new seat-mate is a 20-year-old with swirling rumors surrounding him? A dangerous new romance from the author of Kiss Me at the Stroke of Midnight, Kira-kun Today, and Love's Reach!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

127211.description:
Being in the shadow of his magnificent and famous father, the second generation actor Shou, suffers from a great inferiority complex.
One day Shou meets Souma, another young actor who didn’t finish his studies in high school due to dedicating himself to his acting career, for which he feels overwhelmed to discover the difference of preparation at the level of acting they have.
Meanwhile, Souma can’t hide the anger he feels because he believes that Shou is favored by the environment that surrounds him and entered the entertainment world thanks to contacts, but when did those feelings change?

(Source: Libre Shuppan, translated)

title.native: 愛してるでは重すぎて

127212.description:
- The betrayal is intolerable, while the tricks are irresistible? Let's see how the leading female character says goodbye to the playboy, teaches the angelic bitch a lesson and harvests a double blessing!
- A love trap made up of arrogance and sincerity, would you like to fall into?

On the wedding day, Xiaoka Luo discovered the clandestine love affair between her bridegroom and her best friend by chance. Faced with double betrayal, she chose to divorce the two-timer and focus on her career. The destiny, however, drives her to the love trap set by Nan Xiao, how should Xiaoka Luo deal with the multiple tricks under his arrogant appearance?

(Source: WebComics)

127214.description:
On the eve of the final battle in the arena of Boundless Fairyland, one of the contestants, Dao Buyi/Dirtless Path was murdered in real life by his opponent, Mo Yisha. Dao Buyi/Dao Wuchen did not survive the murder. He vowed to exact revenge from the Mo Family if he were given the chance to return from the dead. A mysterious light shone on him and he was brought back to 2 years ago, to the day Boundless Fairyland was just released. He thought it was all a dream, but the memories of those 2 years were so vivid, it was as if he had been given a second chance.

(Source: WeComics)

127216.description:
On the great continent of Alecrast exists the Kingdom of Swords, Ohfun. Louie, an unorthodox magician with hulking muscles from the Magician's Guild, spent his days surrounded by women, booze, and brawls. But on the night of celebrating his promotion to Sorcerer with his colleague, Aila, he comes across a scuffle between knight apprentices and 3 female adventurers: Merrill, Genie, and Melissa. Unable to resist the urge, Louie jumps into the fray....

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

127217.description:
Night after night, Elva steps forth into the black sea, sword in hand, to drive back the creatures that surge from the waves. Elva is one of the "kannagi," warrior priests chosen by the divine to protect the island. With his snow-white hair, unaging youth, and black-stained limbs—proof of the corruption that gradually takes the life of every kannagi—the local people fear and shun him... at least until his path crosses with that of a boy named Alto. Enraptured by Elva's strength and lonely soul, Alto swears to serve him and free him from his cursed fate.

After eight long years, Alto has grown into a capable and fearless young man, unwavering in his devotion to his kannagi. Elva had long ago resigned himself to an early death—but somehow, Alto's presence seems to be gradually healing him of the black sea's corruption...

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

127218.description:
With the death of his grandfather, Jihoo stands to inherit his company—and a massive amount of wealth. There’s just one catch: he must spend a year with “the person he loves.” But for Jihoo, that’s complicated. Not only did that person, Eun-yul, leave him five years ago, but now she has a kid! Can Jihoo push through years of hard feelings and awkwardness to win her back? Is he really just doing it for the company?

(Source: Tapas)

127220.description:
Manaka, a pervy nerd high school student who secretly draws erotic digital manga, finds himself in a sticky situation with a new friend when some girls in his class who don't normally talk to him ask to borrow his computer. The only thing is...the manga he draws is on that computer! Can he transfer the data before they see it?! A youth romantic comedy that starts from a casual and unexpected event, testing the mental strength of our protagonist...

Can he handle it, or will he reach his mental limit?!

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Is the Defense Club disbanding already?! The anime's scriptwriter Natsuko Takahashi writes this novel with the themes of 'love' and 'the many forms of love'."

127224.description:
In the present era, adventurers, demons, heroes, and demon lord, are no longer occupations that put one's lives at stake. With the world at peace, it is an era where conquering dungeons has been transformed into entertainment. Adventurers and monsters are able to fight with a substitute body made of magic, popularizing dungeon conquests with no deaths. Having lost his job, the “Black Mage” Remme struggled with finding another party until one day a beautiful woman appeared before him telling she had a job for him.

(Source: Comikey)
synonyms: Welcome to the Impregnable Demon King Castle ~The Black Mage Who Got Kicked Out of the Hero Party Due to His Unnecessary Debuffs Gets Welcomed by the Top Brass of the Demon King's Army~

title.english: The Impregnable Demon King's Castle and the Expelled Black Mage of the Hero's Party

127226.description:
“The Hero defeated the Demon King in the war of men against demons…” Those kinds of stories are a thing of the past. Nowadays, adventurers, demons, Heroes, Demon Kings, and so on are all occupations that no longer involve putting one’s life on the line. Peace has returned to the world, and dungeon exploration has now become a form of entertainment. Adventurers and monsters now all fight using clones they’ve created with magic in an extremely popular form of dungeon clearing where nobody dies. The footage of the dungeon getting cleared gets broadcasted all across the continent, and I’m a member of a Hero’s party that was ranked the 4th most popular in the world… but not anymore. Parties had a limitation of 5 members, and I was told that an unpopular job like Black Sorcerer would only get in the way of getting to 3rd place or beyond.

Now that I became unemployed, I was forced to find another party but I just couldn’t find one. One day, I encountered a beautiful blonde red-eyed woman who told me she had a job for me. After being so touched from having someone recognize my abilities far more than my past comrades, I ended up agreeing to take an interview without asking for the details. When I arrived at my destination, I was at the world’s hardest dungeon where no party has ever reached the final area, the Demon King Castle, where the Big Four and the Demon King were waiting for me. This is the story of a Black Sorcerer that was kicked out of a Hero’s party and joined the side of the Demon King Army to repel the Heroes.
synonyms: Welcome to the Impregnable Demon King Castle ~The Black Mage Who Got Kicked Out of the Hero Party Due to His Unnecessary Debuffs Gets Welcomed by the Top Brass of the Demon King's Army~

title.native: 難攻不落の魔王城へようこそ ~デバフは不要と勇者パーティーを追い出された黒魔導士、魔王軍の最高幹部に迎えられる~
title.romaji: Nankoufuraku no Maou-jou e Youkoso: Debuff wa Fuyou to Yuusha Party wo Oidasareta Kuro Madoushi, Maou-gun no Saikou Kanbu ni Mukaerareru

127228.description: The main character and the heroine are university students next to each other in the apartment. Two people who are supposed to be next to each other but do not meet each other strangely.  Still, the two gradually become conscious and attracted to each other.

127229.description: Picking up what appeared to be a runaway girl, next to the cigarette vending machine at a convenience store, Hira Katsuki, the protagonist, reluctantly takes her home to protect her, thinking it would be troublesome to leave her with a handmade cardboard tag around her neck that says "Please pick me up" and that she would be involved in a crime if left unattended. When he asks her why she ran away from home, she continues to joke around about it. The two gradually come to know each other through their conflicting conversations, and promise to live together for one week only. Living together while being unaccustomed to each other, the two of them…
synonyms: Kuudere Sugiru Mirai no Yome no Mendou na Nanokakan
7 Troublesome Days with the Future Bride Who Is Too Kuudere

title.native: クーデレすぎる未来の嫁の面倒な7日間
title.romaji: Kuudere Sugiru Mirai no Yome no Mendouna 7-Kakan

127232.description: Azuma Shuri, a young man who aspires to be a chef, was transported into another world one day. There, the one who gave him a place to stay was the leader of a mercenary corps, Gungrave. While serving as an errand boy, Shuri gradually improves his cooking skills, demonstrating his worth as a cook. His food even managed to get through to each of the squad leaders who each had their own preference of food. Besides that, he also helps out with engineering, lending an ear to their woes and love worries… Eventually, Shuri became an indispensable ally of the mercenary corps. However, he still did not know then. That he himself was going to become the Hero.
synonyms: ยอดกุ๊กสูตรเด็ดเสร็จทั้งกองทัพ

127233.description:
I’ve been reborn as Clea Rino, the world’s most wicked villainess! Before her death, Clea made a deal with the Demon King to marry her true love, Isaac Detroi. To get my life back, I must fulfill that contract for just six months. Guess I didn’t read the fine print, because her body is weak. I lose 1 HP with every step! With time ticking, I’m signing over her family’s fortune for Isaac’s hand in marriage. It’s purely business, so why am I catching feelings? Who knew this villainess had a heart?

(Source: Tapas)

Notes: Chapter count includes 4 side stories
synonyms: The Dying Villainess's Path to a Happy Ending
Happy Ending for the Time-Limited Villainess

余命僅かな悪女にハッピーエンドを
แฮปปี้เอนดิ้งของนางร้ายจำกัดเวลา

127236.description:
An anthology of three Tezuka oneshots from the late 1960's.

1. Daibousou (大暴走/The Runaway Tanker)
Newscaster Goro Tsukinashi is invited to board the world's first atomic-powered, computer-operated oil tanker, the Osakabe Maru. While on its maiden voyage, everything that could go wrong, does go wrong. Can the passengers survive aboard this voyage of the damned?

2. Kojinkyou (虎人境/Land of the Tigermen)
Television director Goro Ibukuro makes his living exploiting the talents of others on his most popular show, World's Cruelest Acts. After hearing about a tribe of "Tigermen" that live in the hinterlands of Borneo that apparently have a miracle cure in the form of a ceremony, he decides to set off and film them. However, he might have taken on more than he bargained for...

3. Kiiro Makyou (黄色魔境/The Spaceman’s Base)
Set during the Occupation of Tripoli during World War II, two American soldiers and a German soldier are held hostage by a Japanese boy who hijacks the Americans' Jeep. The boy's destination is the mysterious ruins of Wadan-Wadan, located in the middle of nowhere. What is the connection between the boy and these ruins?

127241.description:
Monsters have long threatened humanity’s existence. To fight against these beings, Keith, the youngest person to ever become a sage, joins a knight order and shows immense success on the battlefield. However, that doesn’t last long, as a quarrel with an incompetent higher-up gets him fired from the order. With nowhere to go, Keith is assigned as a teacher, and with his talent for bringing out the best in his students, his class is about to reach unbelievable heights...

(Source: MANGA UP!)

127249.description:
Manga adaptation of Part 4 of Honzuki no Gekokujou.

Rozemyne has awoken from her two-year slumber. Everything and everyone has changed, which is as terrifying as it sounds, but she doesn’t have time to waste before she’s thrust toward the Royal Academy—a requirement for becoming a noble. There, she will meet all sorts of colorful teachers and students from other duchies... but can she keep her composure in the face of the most books she’s seen yet? Our bookworm goes to school in the newest installment of this biblio-fantasy by book lovers, for book lovers.

(Source: J-Novel Club)

127252.description:
Kusaka Kouichi is a high-school student with an ero mangaka as his older sister. He lead a pretty ordinary life until summer vacation hit and he found out that his childhood friend, Mia was a succubus. Not only a succubus, she was inexperienced and would be in deep trouble if not trained. As time dragged on, more and more people around Kusaka turned out to be clueless succubi.

Now begins the quest to teach them all the ways of the succubus!
synonyms: I’m an Inexperienced Succubus, So Would You Mind Teaching Me How to Do the Dirty Stuff?

A detective and a medium team up to suppress the ghost of a murderer.

127259.description:
Cong Li is a world-famous screenwriter and superstar actor Ming Gu is her superhot husband…in her dreams that is. In reality, Cong is just a poor college student who ghost writes manuscripts without receiving any credit. After a long night writing, she wakes up the next morning…in Ming’s body?! With control of Ming’s body, Cong has money, fame, and the ability to accomplish her wildest dreams. Just one problem: Ming has control of Cong’s body too. Slowly sabotaging each other’s lives, they have to work together: with Ming as Cong’s assistant. And they say this kind of stuff only happened in the movies…

(Source: Tapas)

127260.description:
"Let's kill your husband... so you can come live with me."

(Source: Manta)

127262.description:
Miya, a keyboardist in the band Aldebaran, awakens to find an unknown man sleeping next to him...! The man's identity is Ritsuki, a music student, who is expected to be a pianist with a promising future. However, the pressure crushes him and he falls into a slump. Miya, who was born into a musical family and has gone through a similar experience, feels compelled to help him...

Notes:
- Includes an extra chapter.
- Includes the one-shot "27star".

127264.description:
Sogo Kawano is a high school student with a severe communication disorder who doesn't have any friends. As such, he spends his days in school avoiding everybody. Sogo's only joy in life is to pet the flowers growing behind the gymnasium. But one day, even though no one else usually comes by there, Tani, a senior, shows up. Sogo gradually finds himself falling for Tani, who's kind and mysteriously attractive. However, Sogo then finds out about Tani's friend, Shun, whom Tani considers "important" to him......

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: ハニーソルトアンドビターシュガー

127265.description:
Problems in love? Don't go to these guys!! A fledgling private eye and his high-strung pretty-boy partner to the rescue! Ginpei Matsuda joined the Natsume Private Investigators to be the "exemplary P.I." he always dreamed of becoming. But his repeated slip-ups earn him nothing but ire from his cruel, cold, and frightening partner, Shun Enomoto. One day, the odd couple take a case to find a young boy's long-lost first-love, and then...!? A labyrinth of love lies just ahead. This frustratingly-tantalizing mismatched-buddy-P.I. love-affair will tickle your expectations!!

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: それでも恋する迷探偵

127268.description: Akane, a high school student who loves pretty faces and is an idol otaku, is being pressed by his handsome childhood friend, Harumi. "Wake me up," "Kiss me," "Stay here." Akane can't resist when he's begging, but he's too thick-headed to notice Harumi's affection for him. They are in a state of "Are they not dating yet?" because they've been really close to each other since they were young. But at one point, Harumi gets serious and approaches Akane...?!

title.native: 幼なじみの顔が良すぎて逆らえない
title.romaji: Osananajimi no Kao ga Yosugite Sakaraenai

127269.description: I fell in love with the boy I picked up! What I picked up was a mischievous, spoiled and tender tiger boy. But have you ever been courted every day by a tiger that has become a great man? Sweet and warm days with the little tiger, but what awaits me with the adult tiger?

title.native: トラの子が♂なのに迫ってくる話
title.romaji: Toranoko ga Osu Nanoni Ottekuru Hanashi

127270.description:
Wu Yue is a 'catnip' descendant- one who carries the fragrance of catnip on her body. Not knowing better, she enrolled in a school that is filled with cat descendants, causing a commotion and to be chased around by them. In the process of escaping, Wu Yue accidentally kissed Li Zechu, a descendant of the jaguar, and unexpectedly discovered that Li Zechu's kiss could somehow camoflage her unique fragrance.
Thus, in order to quell the commotion she had caused and survive in school, Wu Yue had to become Li Zechu’s pet. She would have to endure all sort of harrassments, just for a kiss from Li Zechu...
It is an impossible kind of development. Wu Yue vows to find another solution to this problem and be rid of the control of the demon Li Zechu!

title.romaji: Ni Shi Wo De Mao Bohe

synonyms: Summer Love in the Sea Blue

127273.description:
Mian’s world is torn asunder by a brutal attack on the people of Ba. She is helpless to protect those she loves, but this tragedy awakens the chaos and power of the rare black dragon within her. To aid her safe transformation, she becomes dragonbound with the mysterious Qianyi. Joined by their hopes for a new world and an imperial kill order against their lives, together they embark on a journey to elevate their dragon powers and to defeat the evil and corruption around them.

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: มังกรทะยานฟ้า ท้าปฐพี

127274.description:
Don't make me take my uniform off...! Haru's number one at the place where he works at. They offer carnal services from "high school boys." Despite his cute looks, when he's behind the tinted mirror, he lets his pink tongue glide over the glass, plays with himself, and uses his hand to pleasure himself while seducing his customers on the other side. For Haru, this is the job he was born to do. He's legally an adult, but he wants to be loved as a high school boy... One day, Takashiro comes to him as a new customer. Takashiro is handsome, good at his work, and popular with both men and women. He's the "perfect" guy that everyone wants to be. Except he has a secret. He can only get excited with high school boys. A love story about Takashiro's obsession with high school boys, and their complicated pasts...

(Source: Renta!)
synonyms: Nisemono DK wa Haru wo Uru

title.english: His Secret Life as a Fake High Schooler
title.native: おれの制服を脱がせてよ
title.romaji: Ore no Seifuku wo Nugasete yo

127275.description:
Akito Takaoka spends his days teaching classics to high school students and his nights having meaningless one-night stands with other men. Last night was supposed to be just another fling, but when he wakes up, the cute guy next to him laughs and says, "So you really didn't recognize me?" Akito can't believe it... He actually slept with Shindo... one of his students! Shindo continues to pursue Akito while at school, and though Akito vowed never to get romantically (or physically) involved with a student, Shindo's gaze alone sets his blood aflame. He knows it's wrong, but he wants more...!

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: You're a Glutton for Punishment. Right, Teach?
title.native: ドM、淫乱、欲しがり。全部先生のことでしょ？
title.romaji: Do-M, Inran, Hoshigari. Zenbu Sensei no Koto Deshou?

127276.description:
Min Joon thought studying abroad in Japan would mean the beginning his fabulous gay life. But instead, he’s scammed by his boyfriend, loses his passport and is basically screwed. What’s worse, a kid comes up to him calling him “Mama” and before he knows it, he’s being kidnapped by the yakuza. Then the hot yakuza boss makes him an offer he can’t refuse… so now it’s either be “Mama” to his little kid or to not live at all. What to do, what to do? And this yakuza boss is just too hot for his own good…

(Source: Lezhin US)

When a Yakuza Falls in Love

127281.description:
Each and every being has a wondrous story to tell, if you'll listen. Long, long ago, there once lived a beautiful mage. The mage had but only one spell: the strange ability to turn the twinkle of life into gems. It was a powerless magic that couldn't save anyone, but the mage believed in it, witnessing all the comedies and all the tragedies across the universe and weaving them into tales with wondrous luster. And so, the curtain rises on a heart-stirring fairy-tale fantasy!

(Source: Kodama Tales)

By a turn of events, the clueless about love, Katsuyuki, and the school's new madonna from Tokyo, Haru, start to become close with one another. Beautiful, fickle, miserable, painful. A first love coming of age mystery.

The members of the Ikkoku High School Manga Club work hard every day to become manga artists and editors! The comical days of drawing manga, wearing costumes, and attacking each other with whips begin now!

(Source: Jump Comics, translated)

127288.description: While having absolutely no talent for magic, Wynn trained his body every day to achieve his dream, becoming a Knight protecting his country. Compensating his lack of magic with his abnormal physical abilities alone, he entered the school to become knight a few years ago. Until one day, the little girl 2 years younger than him who followed his hard training every day suddenly came back to him after several years. And when that young woman, who became the saviour of the world by defeating the Demon King himself, calls Wynn her "Master," the tale of the "Master of the Brave" knight apprentice begins.

127289.description:
Three years ago, Chrono Crawford found himself sent to another world on the day of his high school entrance exams. Today, he serves as both a lord and general commanding an army of demihumans. In a world where his soldiers face discrimination and hardship, Chrono must use his experience in both worlds to bring about equality for all races. But when a beautiful half-elf girl appears in his bedroom to confess her love, his mission gets a whole lot more personal! Is he ready to start navigating the sexy women of this fantasy world?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

127307.description:
The 12-year-old boy entrusted his destiny to the dying nation!

Hercule is a boy who was raised as a successor to the declining Lemuria empire. Hercule has been crowned as the new Emperor of the empire, which is on the verge of being destroyed by the previous emperor, but in fact he has a secret that no one knows about...? This is the story of a young emperor who becomes the savior of the Lemuria empire and the champion of the three continents.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: Heroic Chronicles of the Three Continents
Heroic Chronicles of The Three Continents: Chronicles of Empire Rebuilding with Modern Knowledge
三大陸英雄記 ~現代知識による帝国再建記~

127308.description:
Emperor Ludis suffered an unjustified death because of his Emperor’s Mark, which allowed him to make servants out of monsters. But instead of dying for good, he reincarnated a thousand years into the future. His previous life gave him no freedom, so this time, he’ll take it all and travel the world as an adventurer! But although he pretends to be normal, he gathers servants again and becomes the strongest adventurer! Come see what adventures await Ludis in this monster-filled isekai fantasy!

(Source: MANGA UP!)
synonyms: The Reincarnated Sage Who Possesses the Mark of the Emperor That Commands Obedience From Monsters ~Quietly Becoming the Strongest Adventurer With the Magic from His Previous Life Alongside His Monster Subordinates~

127310.description:
The meeting between a normal boy and a witch liberates the world from its curse...

I'm a magic apprentice. "My master", who has been living under this same run-down roof with me, is a shut-in girl who proclaimed herself to be a great witch. Despite sounding all high-and-mighty, my defenseless master loves to watch her disciple cooking for her. Our daily lives, filled with happiness, go by quietly. However, little did I know that behind that quiet, happy daily life is a terrible secret that involves the fate of the world...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

You Are the Cindery Witch That Will Not Die

Katsuhisa, who can't seem to remember people's faces, gets into trouble after a robber thought the high school student caught him in action.

Book one of the Boukyaku Series. Collects three stories:
1. ちょっとだけハードボイルド (Chotto Dake Hardboiled)
2. コレクター (Collector)

Rui is gone!

The clue is within the Kuroda family's ongoing internal conflict.

1. 家族の肖像 (Kazoku no Shouzou)

127318.description:
It all started with that encounter...

This time, Katsuhisa gets tangled with the mafias!

Book three of the Boukyaku series. Collects three stories:

2. 代名詞の迷宮 (Daimeishi no Meikyuu)

127320.description:
A new era of military entertainment begins!

Year 20YX. Global warming is causing sea ice to decrease in the Arctic Ocean. The Maritime Self-Defense Force destroyer Shiranui, on which Kaburaki, a candidate to become the next captain of the Ibuki, is dispatched to conduct research. Suddenly, a civilian research vessel is attacked by someone...! The "Shiranui" quickly uses its weapons to protect the civilian ship, but...! Who attacked it? What was the reason for the attack!

(Source: Bookwalker, translated)

127321.description: Paralysis, memory impairment, aphasia—all caused by brain disorders. What neurosurgeons treat isn’t just the brain—it’s patients’ lives. A highly authentic medical drama written by a former neurosurgeon! / There are approximately 1.12 million patients with cerebrovascular disease in Japan. And many of them are struggling with some form of aftereffects. Tomoharu Sanpei, who has transferred from a hospital in the U.S. to a major suburban hospital, doesn’t read the room. Yet this behavior is characteristic of a neurosurgeon, for whom even the slightest delay can determine the course of a patient’s life. CEO Liam Bian is young, brash, and charismatic. He knows what he wants, and he’ll take it, even if it means rolling up his sleeves and bloodying his knuckles. But he meets his match in Miles Han, the steely heir to a conglomerate that’s out to destroy Liam’s own budding empire. When Liam confronts Miles with a baseball bat, it’s fuel that turns their rivalry into an inferno, sparking an attraction that burns red hot. Now they’ll do anything in business—and in the bedroom—to take the other down.

(Source: Tapas)

127436.description:
"Why didn't you accept my bouquet?", she asked years later like it was the simplest thing. Chance brought Ju-Na back into Yun-Seo's life but things were much more complicated now. They were no longer in college where the only obstacle between them were the truth yet spoken. Luna was married with a child, what could Yun-Seo do? As Sae-Ha chases after Yun-Seo, Yun-Seo discovers even after all these years she'd still love Ju-Na at the drop of a hat. The three women navigate through their feelings for another, each desperate and yearning for a chance to be accepted.

(Source: Pocket Comics)
synonyms: あなたは違うと言ったけど

127437.description:
Tadashi Endou has gone through a traumatic experience that's forced him to become a shut in. With walls lined end-to-end with mysterious photographs he cannot remember taking, the only person he really sees is his classmate Sumida, who shows up every day with class printouts. But as the mysteries behind Endou's life start to reach a breaking point, he learns that Sumida isn't an actual person in his class! What else will his recovered memories reveal and what will it mean for his life?

(Source: Irodori Comics)

Green Tea Bitch (n.): A woman who pretends to be pure and innocent but in fact is manipulative and calculating.

After school ends, a good honor student is threatened by the class's green tea bitch.

"I never thought you wide-eyed goody-two-shoes would do something like this."
"If you don't want me to expose your shameful secret..."

A cute romance that stems from a misunderstanding begins in That Time I Was Blackmailed By the Class's Green Tea Bitch!

Note: Originally completed with 41 chapters (including extras and bonus chapters) on 2022-02-28. A second season was announced on 2024-09-14.

As an unexpected descendant of a cursed family of mermaids, Eun-Woo's only hope of survival is to never fall in love. For years this was easy enough, until one day he's forced to confront his childhood friend and first kiss, Tae-Ho. But why has he come back, toying with Eun-Woo's heart? Can Eun-Woo resist Tae-Ho's pull or will he succumb to his hidden feelings, and ultimately, disaster?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes eight extras.

127444.description:
Toru Aikawa is a university student who spends his days going through the motions of attending school and working at a local convenience store. The only time he really feels alive is when he’s playing the massive multiplayer VR game Real World Online. One day, he has a stroke of luck: he’s hit by a runaway bus and reincarnated as his game character. But something’s gone wrong... Instead of the invincible warrior he mains, he’s in the body of Nacht Schatten, the alluring dragon princess he made as a joke! Nacht’s build is anything but optimized—she would never survive in the cutthroat world of an isekai story! And more to the point, she’s a girl! But perhaps things aren’t as bad as they seem. Perhaps Nacht Schatten is more capable than she appears.

(Source: J-Novel Club)

127446.description:
Saburou, a first-year university student who’s daily life consisted of nothing but laziness found the joy of muscle training and started hanging out in the bodybuilding club. Will Saburou be able to lose his stomach and change himself…? Or perhaps…

Macho Max Reborn seeks to tell the story of who’s more popular with the ladies, bodybuilders or arm wrestlers. This battle will take the shape of a mixer.

Note: This manga created a stir in the manga community in 2011 for being the first to focus on bodybuilding. "Manga Sunday" would host multiple entries for Macho★Max and Macho★Max Reborn which still hadn’t been published separately and was then later digitally published. Additionally, "Read Comics" had made an article about "The guys afterschool gym".

The wandering soul tries to find himself in the battlefield with only one reason to live.

127450.description:
Not long after the vicious dragons hid their presence on the continent, Knight Commander Alexander is dispatched to investigate the sharp fall in tax revenue. Alexander gets lost in unfamiliar lands and runs into a man named Kline. But this man, as soon as he meets Alexander, starts calling out by his nickname and gets closer by acting friendly, saying that he has waited a long time. And under his half-worn cloak, Alex sees a dragon's horn?!

Kline knows how to use magic and Alexander becomes interested in recruiting him as a knight...

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Four tyrants. Which one of them is my father?! After working herself to death, professor Jae-Hee Cheon is reincarnated as a princess in a fantasy novel. Now, she must find her father from the four candidates before her, or face death — again. Will Jae-Hee get her happy ending?

(Source: Manta)

127456.description:
Syltina was originally a Duke’s daughter.

Sentenced to exile two years ago, she crossed over to the neighboring country and entered its Guild. The current Syltina, who became strong to the extent that even foreign countries knew her name, was summoned by the country which exiled her.

In order to purify the land defiled by monsters, Syltina gets stuck in a journey with a partner who constantly has zero motivation, the girl from the different world who drove her into banishment, the First Prince who was her former fiance, her former brother who is a Knight and a pointlessly shy magician.

This is the story of Syltina slicing off enemies, playing the part of a Straight Man (tsukkomi) and sometimes, the Fool (boke) to her companions.

127460.description: Azusa Wakaba, the daughter of Azusa Fumiko, famous film actress, jumps into the film industry with her beauty to find the truth behind her mother's mysterious suicide. Wakaba catches the eye of Murase Takayuki, a man on the verge of a promotion to director, and wins the lead role, but Murase loses his job to his mentor, Makiguchi, a master of the film industry. In a world where lust becomes murderous intent and hatred abounds, Wakaba's starring film is...

127461.description: Hayashi, the author who won the Newcomer’s Award, depicts a group of four high school girls who take a trip to Taiwan in this new Young Champion serialization! Awao Fumi, whose parents run a restaurant and are interested in Taiwanese cuisine, is invited on a trip by Inuyama Ichi, a blogger who wanted to ride on the wave of the Taiwan boom. They meet a Taiwanese exchange student, Lin Hsu He, who agrees to be their guide. Joined by the school idol Miho Komachi, who lived in Taiwan during her childhood, they all decided to travel to Taiwan together. However, due to Komachi’s characteristic impulses, she booked a 2-day 1-night tour which requires them to depart the next morning! This is an impromptu tour that the four have not prepared for.

127462.description: One fateful day, after enduring months of abuse from her husband Ryou, Nana strangles him to death. She revels in her newfound freedom knowing she won't have to face his abuse again. But her dreams of a peaceful life are destroyed when her husband, the one she killed and stuck in the freezer, comes back from the dead.

Allowing their desires to be hurled onto him, he channels the experience through his brush. To him, it need not matter if he or the other party are gravely wounded in exchange for the fulfillment of their desire. Because the very act itself, is what brings the other party their "happiness"...

"Exactly, what am I?" A human-made robot that is used for battles meets a blind girl, Lilina, while running away. He is slowly captivated by Lilina as she doesn't see him as a robot, but suddenly someone who targets the both of them appears? Moreover, Lilina also has a secret of her own?

127467.description: College orientation. A boy more beautiful than he has ever seen before, Sunakawa, has Murata falling in love at first sight. Living his everyday life as a straight man without giving it second thought turns on its head, with his sudden confession ending tragically in rejection. Undeterred, he sets his heart on becoming the “bottom” to his “top,” always doing his best and looking for opportunities to get closer day after day. Despite turning pale with anger and astonishment at Murata’s advances, before long Sunakawa becomes unable to ignore him…. A good looking top x average looking straight guy - an anything-goes (?) battle of love begins??!?

Two girls who have always been together wrestle with how their relationship changes when they get to college and meet new people.

127472.description:
Yuki Yasaka, 14 years old. She is a girl at Hamanasu Junior High, an all-boys boarding school. Her life at the boys' school, filled with men who move with their instincts, is far more crazy than Yasaka ever imagined! The only person who knows Yasaka's secret that she is a woman is her classmate Shiraishi, and their confused days continue.
A new kind of coming-of-age gag!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

He thought he was used to being alone and was ready to live his life that way at his new school, but his charismatic classmate Keiji plans otherwise!

127475.description:
Tatsuya Matsui and Taiga Kuroda are two people who get into fights while exploring various places… but actually they are just looking for public bathhouses in search of the best soak!!

127476.description: Kagami Rio is now grown up and in college. He's also doing part time job as a model. That's when he met an editor named Asahina Ritsu, who has the same black hair and same green-colored eyes similar to his unrequited love Shingo. But are they of same species too? And how will their relationship turn out to be?

127477.description:
The very popular different world comedy in Kakuyomu is finally made into a book!

Without being run over by a truck, Katou, a high school student with a chuunibyou disease was summoned to another world. “Now, I’m gonna be the strongest harem protagonist!”, at this time a mysterious “Login Bonus” was given to the delighted Katou!?

Elixir on the first day, on the second day is an elf princess (beautiful girl), a magic sword (that can transform into a little girl) on the third day. In addition, he can get even more login bonuses, and powerful cheats increase every day just by him living!!

And then Katou noticed. With this power, he can freely explore the other world, even the Demon Lord and Spirit Lord were added to his harem and ― “I’ll take the world with this power!!” Katou’s most enjoyable life in a different world begins now! The popular different world comedy from the Web has begun!!

Lin Miaoke's life consists of sucking up to others. At a young age, she stuck to her grandfather, the Emperor. After he passed, she latched onto her uncle. In the end, she became someone for others to suck up to. Follow her story in this flourishing world.

WALL-E is a trash compactor robot — the last one of his kind! — and every day for hundreds of years he's faithfully cleaned and organized the millions of tons of trash left behind on Earth by humans. But his routine is flipped upside down when he finds a tiny green plant, the first new sign of life for centuries! When the sleek new robot EVE shows up to take the proof of life back to humanity, WALL-E falls head over wheels in love and eagerly follows her across the galaxy into a whole new adventure!

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

127488.description:
The right arm of the medic holds the death and fate of the battlefield in his palm— The Kingdom and the Empire were engaged in harsh battle. A combat medic corps of the Stars, the Kingdom’s elite unit, led by captain Medic was assigned to escort a newcomer of Stars, Lilith. The strongest medic march into a battlefield of certain death to save the girl who rejects sacrifice—!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Seon-U became a local school lecturer because of a famous painter. One day, the girl who he had dreamed the one on his paintings appeared in front of him as a student. With her beautiful mom…

127498.description: 13-year-old Hasegawa Ichigo has always been a happy, energetic child. As she came into adolescence, though, she noticed that she had a tendency to make terrifying faces when speaking to boys she liked. Now she is entering middle school, along with her dog-eared childhood friend Chihiro. Before their first day, she meets a boy from the same school, who hands her some odd creature, claiming she dropped it. She likes the boy (and thus scares him off with her expression), but keeps the strange creature. Now she's starting school with problems already in place: a boy she likes but can't stop make death glares at, and a strange creature of unknown provenance and purpose.

127500.description:
A devastating accident lands Eun-Ha Seo in the hospital. Mysteriously, she wakes up 12 years younger in her 22-year-old body. Life has given Eun-Ha a second chance, but this is not the life she remembers. Memories blur with reality as she navigates the unfamiliar friendships and romances of this parallel time. Like a surreal game of “what if?,” Eun-Ha is torn between the excitement of a new past and a longing for the life and love she once had. Will Eun-Ha ever find solace? Only time will tell.

(Source: Tapas)

title.native: サムライ・オーヴァドライブ ―桜花の殺陣―

127503.description: Instead of borrowing the power of the earring and gaining strong strength, the people of Miao are suppressed by their side effects, the two families Aewol and Fan-Hwa who survived the crisis of extinction hundreds of years ago, both live quietly in the western part of the continent, serving as a guard for Dang Ju-Hwan. One day, 'Juno' a representative of the God of Yokai, descends to the ground and pronounces a 'trial' on the people of Miao. If they can't solve the mysterious ordeal, the two of them will disappear and the people of Miao will disappear from the earth..! Can Aewol and Fan-Hwa overcome this crisis? And why did the ordeal come to Miao?

127509.description:
A new mobile game called Arcana Fantasy is all the rage across the globe. But here’s the game’s big secret: once a player decides to join the game, they’re unwittingly transported into a virtual world and trapped there until somebody beats the boss to clear the game. Yoon started the game to find his missing father, but now he’s in much more trouble than he bargained for. Will Yoon and his companions be able to find his father and escape from the blurred reality of this virtual imprisonment?

(Source: Lezhin X)

Note: Winner of the Excellence Award in Lezhin's 4th World Comic Competition.

127511.description:
Queen Kristian was framed by her half-sister and executed at just 16 years old. Another sixteen years have passed since then, and the daughter of a duke is about to make her societal debut—her name is Tiaresia. Always close at hand is her loyal servant, growing more impatient by the day. In truth, this handsome servant is a demon, waiting to reap the rewards of a magical contract made with Tiaresia—the reincarnated former queen Kristian. Together, they plan to exact a calculated and tragic revenge.

(Source: Manga UP! Global)

Ginpei Ebisawa is considered a delinquent. But that's not his true nature (maybe).

As he continues his (misguided) quest to learn about himself, he meets his classmate Chigusa Somei (a monster with a desire for 120% approval) and discovers the dangerous depths of philosophy!

The wheels of adolescence are now set in motion for two people with mutual interests...!

127521.description:
On an SNS-slash-dating site for gay men, Tsumugi posts pictures of his adorable handmade plush dolls as the popular crafter "Bee." Out of all his online followers, he gets along best with fellow crafter "Chitan☆" - his gushing fanboy on the feed and his sexy dom in the DMs! When Tsumugi gathers his courage and offers they meet offline, "Chitan☆" insists that his appearance might set him off - how bad of a face are we talking here?

(Source: Futekiya)

127522.description:
Lupin the Third gets...MARRIED? In his trip to Italy, sporting a brand new blue jacket, master thief Lupin weds Rebecca Rossellini, a wealthy adrenaline junkie, much to the chagrin of his allies Daisuke Jigen, Goemon, and on-off girlfriend/rival Fujiko Mine. And so begins the mysterious adventures of Italy and San Marino, where Lupin evades his longtime enemy Inspector Zenigata, and meets a rogues gallery of new faces, foes and friendly.

Note: This is an adaptation of the fourth part of the anime.

127523.description: Doctor Migawa runs a small clinic on the heights of the village of Nasu, the doctor is also a fishing expert. Immerse yourself in this moving story that tells us about the joys and sorrows of Doctor Migawa and the people of Nasu.

127524.description:
Fushimi Ren lives by "lacking" death. He wishes to complete what he is lacking, in other words, he wants to die. On his way back home, he meets a girl, Sherazade, who loves "lack." This self-proclaimed witch said that she will grant Ren's wish, but...

Kurei Yukito made a wish on the verge of dying. In his next life, he would like to become someone who can understand other people. However, the next time Yukito woke up, he had been reincarnated to a different world in the midst of war. Moreover, he was granted a cheat skill as a result of misunderstanding his last wish.

He was picked up by the rebel Prince, worked as the go-between of messengers from other countries and did his best to talk to them despite his poor social skills. Yukito desperately lived in this different world in order to accomplish his dying wish.

Nevertheless...

In this world where wars are common, hints of war gradually crept up to Yukito...

title.native: 転生! 竹中半兵衛 マイナー武将に転生した仲間たちと戦国乱世を生き抜く
title.romaji: Tensei! Takenaka Hanbei: Minor Bushou ni Tensei Shita Nakamatachi to Sengokuransei wo Ikinuku

title.native: 成人すると塩になる世界で生き残る話
title.romaji: Seijin suru to Shio ni Naru Sekai de Ikinokoru Hanashi

127537.description: The president of Mujina Company, Najimu Mujina, isn't an adult, nor does she possess a genius intellect; she's a very ordinary 5-year-old girl. Followed by her indulgent and talented secretary, an office clerk of unknown nationality, and an employee who plays the straight man, the president charges into the world every day.

127538.description:
Expert soldier Taiga has just retired from the military after twenty years of service. Listless, he decides a visit to his homeland of Japan will help him figure out what to do next. But he never arrives. A strange earthquake in the airport seems to spell his demise, but instead it transports him to Million Dungeon, a labyrinthine world of caverns, kingdoms, magic...and monsters. The key to survival is apparently creating his own nation, but even with all of Taiga’s experience, the incredible dangers may prove too much...

(Source: Yen Press)

title.english: Meikyuu: Labyrinth Kingdom, A Tactical Fantasy World Survival Guide
title.native: 迷宮キングダム 特殊部隊SASのおっさんの異世界ダンジョンサバイバルマニュアル!
title.romaji: Meikyuu Kingdom: Damu Tokushu Butai SAS no Ossan no Isekai Dungeon Survival Manual!

127541.description: Prisoner Haga was tired of his boring life in jail and thought of staging a jailbreak! Just at that moment, an alpha prison officer was assigned to him...?

title.native: 羽賀くんは噛まれたい

A yandere girl who won't let anyone else have you!!

127543.description:
Next, you need to clear me. ❤

title.romaji: Daigaku Debut ni Shippai Shita Bocchi, Makyou ni Seisokusu.

127545.description:
Things are about to get complicated when two brothers end up with a widowed stepmother.

(Source: Toomics)

127547.description:
Linaria Girls' School is a traditional boarding school for junior and high school students. This is a comedy about first-year junior high girls who do things, or don't do anything, at their own pace.

(Source: Ganma!, translated)

127548.description:
Three years ago Tora and Ryota were an unbeatable pitching duo. The two were feared on the mound and were admired off. These days, Tora is a himbo ne'er-do-well and Ryota is slaving over ramen in his hometown. Furthermore Ryota is being set up for marriage by his family. So when Tora hears that his old partner might get taken off the board, he makes a beeline for home hoping to score big with his old teammate. The love between two former ball players can be a little bit of a swing-and-a-miss and a little bit of a homerun. But either way some one is going to score in this romance-comedy!

(Source: Kuma)

6. Aa, Yukue Fumei (ああ、ゆくえふめい, Man, I'm Lost); Reijin 2011-07

127551.description: Pocket Monsters BW: Good Partners is a Pokémon manga based on the games Pokémon Black and White.

title.native: ポケットモンスターB・W グッドパートナーズ

127552.description:
Man Qian is a university student who has quite the crush on Chang Le, a boy from the comedy club. She tries her best to convey her feelings, but can't confess to him without laughing. Her journey of trying to confess her feelings begins with a busy college life and nonstop laughter.

(Source: INKR)
