title.english: Unable To Confess To Chang Le
title.native: 常乐同学令我无法告白
title.romaji: Chang Le Tongxue Ling Wo Wufa Gaobai

127553.description:
Due to the destruction of his home, mountain god Chen Shan entered the entertainment circle and accidentally became the film emperor. Meanwhile, the slow and adorable snail monster Lin Wo went down the mountain to seek shelter with Chen Shan. Although he was the film emperor's assistant in name, in reality he was the one being taken care of every day. These two helped similar monsters everywhere in the entertainment circle. They rebuilt the homes of displaced monsters, bringing about a pure camaraderie in which they could share their laughter and tears.

(Source: Tapas)

127554.description:
The neighborhood cock of the walk is more than just an ordinary rooster—he’s humanity’s greatest defender! His opponents may be ten stories tall, but nothing is bigger than his stout heart and his fearsome battle cry—cock-a-doodle-doo!

(Source: VIZ Media)
synonyms: ยอดไก่นักสู้กู้โลก

title.native: ニワトリ・ファイター

127555.description:
Soraguchi Maho. Or Kuro Mahou as she is more commonly known. As the nickname suggests, her hobby is black magic. Though she is as sharp-tongued as could be in private, she has trouble communicating when she is with others. What you would call a lion at home, and a mouse abroad.

However, one day, with the help of a grimoire, she is able to summon a demon. To get back at her classmates, Maho immediately tells the demon, "Please make me beautiful." The price of the contract, however, is her heart! "You are not allowed to fall in love with anyone." "That's easy!" Thinking the contract to be generous, she agrees. She should have achieved a happy life after gaining the appearance she wanted, however...?!

A heartful love comedy set at school about a gloomy girl. Won the MF Bunko J newcomer award.

title.native: ネクラ少女は黒魔法で恋をする
title.romaji: Nekura Shoujo wa Kuro Mahou de Koi wo Suru

title.native: 可愛い女子が勉強を教えてくれると思った俺がバカでした
title.romaji: Kawaii Joshi ga Benkyou wo Oshiete Kureru to Omotta Ore ga Baka Deshita

127557.description:
I'm a villainess... it seems!? No, no, I'm not such a bad woman-!!

Liz Beltran is an arrogant, selfish young woman, and a villainous one at that.

When Liz arrives for her formal marriage meeting with the first prince, Alan, she is shocked to hear his younger brother's voice speaking to him.

What do you mean, "villainess"? I'm not such a lousy woman!

She is shocked and teary-eyed, but her marriage partner, Alan, tells her: "I'll be your fiancé and help you out so you don't end up becoming a villainess.".

She struggles to understand incomprehensible words such as "target" and "game world", but, at the same time, she is thrilled by the too-sweet guidance of the beautiful Prince Alan as she strives to get back at the prince's brother!

With the help of the prince who is "apparently" about to break off their engagement, Liz strives to become a perfect lady in this unique romantic comedy about a villainous lady!

(Source: Julian Publishing, translated)

title.native: 悪役令嬢になりたくないので、王子様と一緒に完璧令嬢を目指します！
title.romaji: Akuyaku Reijou ni Naritakunainode, Ouji-sama to Issho ni Kanpeki Reijou wo Mezashimasu!

synonyms: Die Legende von Azfareo – Der Silberdrache

title.native: 蒼竜の側用人〜白銀の竜編〜
title.romaji: Azufareo no Sobayounin: Shirogane no Ryuu-hen

127559.description:
Kosuke is distressed by his failed love life. Working as a flight dispatcher, every day is hectic, causing the relationships with his boyfriends to turn sour. His pilot friend and work colleague, Ayumu, is a shoulder to lean on, and is also the only one that knows of Kosuke's sexual orientation. One night, mistaking Ayumu for his boyfriend, Kosuke embraces his friend, someone he treasures dearly, but never intended to cross that line with! What will become of their relationship!?

(Source: Renta!)
synonyms: 榊昴祐的飛行員攻略計劃

title.native: 榊くんのフライトプラン

127560.description:
One day, I, Sakura Minakami, fell into the bath, and when I realized it, I was on an unfamiliar bed! Even though I was misunderstood by the room owner and had a crisis of chastity, because he was a handsome knight who was exactly my type, I was inadvertently "eaten deliciously" on the spot.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: I Tripped Into a Different World Where I Was Eaten on the Spot

title.native: 異世界トリップしたその場で食べられちゃいました
title.romaji: Isekai Trip Shita Sono ba de Taberarechaimashita

127561.description: She's tough, smart, and cool when she's at work, but in private she has a masochist fetish. When she met that handsome man with the cold stare, he seemed like a dream come true. He even propositioned her to have sex with him. So what's his big secret!?

title.native: グロリアスドーン　アイキャッチ

127564.description:
When the Monster Army invaded Earth thirteen years ago, the Divine Dragon Rangers rose up to stop them! With the war raging on, these great heroes are mankind’s last hope!

…or are they?

In truth, the invaders were subjugated within a year, forced to continue to crank out a monster a week for the Rangers to crush in front of their adoring fans! But one monster has had enough. Something has to change! He’ll rebel against the might of the Dragon Rangers and destroy them all…from the inside!

(Source: Kodansha USA)
synonyms: ขบวนการกำมะลอ

title.native: 桃色大戦ぱいろん～アナザ・パラドクス～
ルナティック・シュガー　倫敦の魔術師の渇愛
title.romaji: Lunatic Sugar: London no Majutsushi no Katsuai
Loop the Loop: Houshoku no Yakata

127569.description:
Tigur, a young archer who works for Eren, the warrior princess of the Principality of Lightmeritz, and Lim, Eren's second-in-command. For some reason, the two are now isolated in the midst of Asvar, an enemy nation that has suddenly invaded Zystart. There, they are told an unbelievable story by Princess Guinevere of Asvar. Artorius, the founder of Asvar, who is supposed to be 300 years old, has suddenly risen from the dead and has taken control of the country in the blink of an eye. The two decide to cooperate with Guinevere, but they are confronted by a mysterious man who has more power with a bow than Tiggle, and who calls Tiggle "the king of this generation." In a foreign land, Tigur and Lim are confronted by a fearsome enemy.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)
synonyms: คาร์นเวนันกับราชันศรมนตรา

title.native: 魔弾の王と聖泉の双紋剣
title.romaji: Madan no Ou to Seisen no Carnwenhan

127570.description:
Dongfang Feifei, the best actress of the Golden Tiger Award, is well-known for her beauty and love experience with playboys. But she goes back to her 17 after her rebirth. And she has to get into the Ivy league to avoid being killed. But in face of this situation, Dongfang Feifei shouts:" Gosh!" I'm not well-educated. How can I possibly make it?"

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: Rather Than Being an Award Winning Actress, It's Better to Study at Qing Hua

title.english: 17 Again: Smart is the New Sexy
title.romaji: Dang Ying Hou Buru Nian Qinghua

127571.description: A female teacher, living in an abandoned bus.

127572.description:
I'll die if you touch me!

A romantic comedy about an ultra-sensitive assassin, who happens to be a schoolgirl!

title.native: かんどちゃんには触っちゃダメ！

127573.description:
Yulia reincarnates into a minor subcharacter of an otome game before the start of the main story and the one she is employed under as a maid is the princess who will make an appearance as the game's villain?!

"As if I would allow such an adorable princess to become a villainess!" With that resolution in her mind, Yulia will use the knowledge from her previous life as an office lady as well as the livelihood magic only she can use to guide the princess along in place of finding love for herself!

Rumors of Yulia's capability as a maid spread as she heads the development of sweets, the manufacturing of local specialties, and even gets involved in the trouble between two countries?! This is a fantasy story of a competent maid who has fortuitously found her life's calling.
synonyms: I Was Reincarnated, and Now I'm a Maid!

title.native: 転生しまして、現在は侍女でございます。
title.romaji: Tensei Shimashite, Genzai wa Jijo de Gozaimasu.

127574.description:
Sarah, a girl raised by the demon Asmodeus, has become a demonologist who studies demons. In order to spend her retirement years comfortably and live off of royalties, she aims to write an encyclopedia of demons. But what is the true identity of the next demon that appears before her?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: The Encyclopedia of Sarah Cornelius the Demonologist

title.native: 悪魔学者サラ＝コルネリウスの大事典
title.romaji: Akuma Gakusha Sarah Cornelius no Daijiten

127575.description: I died. When I woke up, I was in the world of the Otome Game [Rose Garden]…? No way! What’s more, I was reborn as the girl with the reputation of [Unlucky • Unrequited • Pathetic], that is to say, the old royal family’s princess, the Heroine’s rival, Remilia-sama isn’t it?! However, I prefer the main couple! I would like to watch the love of the Princess and Ryuko if possible! Political dispute of the new and old royal family? I want to live peacefully and safely regardless of it! And that is, to sometimes leisurely take a walk in the sky with a dragon. A fantasy of magic and dragon that can be folded as [Let’s Quit being a Villain • Let’s Give up the First Love • Get Straight to Home].
synonyms: The Villainous Daughter does not Dance with the Dragon

title.native: 悪役令嬢は、ドラゴンとは踊らない
title.romaji: Akuyaku Reijou wa, Dragon to wa Odoranai

127576.description:
In a world of royalty and magic, a young Japanese woman is reincarnated as Princess Luxeria. But the princess is born with magical abilities so strong and terrible that she agrees to live her life locked away in a tower. When her family is betrayed and her royal parents are murdered, she’s forced to step out of her self-imposed exile and into a treacherous world. Princess Luxeria must pretend to be the perfect puppet ruler…all while concealing her burning desire for vengeance.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

127577.description:
Isamu has the intimidating looks of a (rumored) yakuza lady, which makes her isolated and lonely at school. One day, her father hires a housekeeper, Tsune, who looks like a (rumored) thug himself. A pure love story between two people who look like criminals in appearance only.

Note: Includes two extra chapters.
synonyms: 小姐, 起床時間到了
Lady, it's time to wake up

title.native: お嬢、お目覚めの時間です
使徒戦記 ことなかれ貴族と薔薇姫の英雄伝
title.romaji: Shito Senki: Koto Nakare Kizoku to Barahime no Eiyuuden

127579.description:
The final summer of middle school, Shoutarou Futaba discovers boys gymnastics and is completely enamored by it. Shoutarou ends up going to Soushuukan Private High School and decides to visit the boys gymnastics club. He's greeted by very unique senpais and a star gymnast named Ryouya Misato. Dedicating your life to something you love during your fiery days of youth... Of course, there is frustration, and fights, but see how these boys work together as a team towards a similar goal in this drama about sports and youth.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

127580.description:
In a time when the 6 Goddesses of the world vanished without a trace, a hunter by the name of Wein miraculously stumbles upon a girl who calls herself Elise, claiming to be the 7th Goddess. After finding himself in a losing battle against a monster and suffering severe wounds, Wein was on the brink of death. With the help of Elise's powers, he was able to cling onto dear life. But as an aftermath of exerting her power, Elise's body turned into a little girl...

In order to restore Elise's lost power, Wein and his friends set off on an adventure!!

title.native: 剣と魔法のログレス 厄災の女神
title.romaji: Ken to Mahou no Logres: Yakusai no Megami

127581.description:
Akira Tennou—an unremarkable thirty-five-year-old janitor—has got a lot to complain about. He was hit by a truck, unintentionally dragged into a hero-summoning spell, and now he's stuck in some random gloomy forest in a parallel world. And he's probably afflicted by a dark curse now, if his sister's beloved fantasy manga are to be believed. The ominous shadows everywhere don't give him much hope for his new life, especially when they're also attached to the giant wolf that just snuck up behind him…

But while this world does come with a curse, it also comes with something awesome: magic. Akira's got the power to purify, and he's gonna use it to free the creatures of the forest! Trying to fi gure out how magic works without a teacher isn't going to be easy, but he's not gonna let some stupid curse get between him and a bunch of cute animals!

(Source: J-Novel Club)
synonyms: Summoned to Another World... Purification Is Basic!

title.english: Flung into a New World? Time to Lift the 200-Year Curse!
title.native: 異世界に落とされた…浄化は基本!
title.romaji: Isekai ni Otosareta… Jouka wa Kihon!

title.native: リビングデッド・ファスナー・ロック

127584.description:
Ishuto was the strongest Demon Lord in the Dark Continent until he was defeated by the heroes. But instead of dying, he reincarnated into another world as a young man, while still keeping his powers. "I will start from scratch in this world and this time it'll be mine!". The elite adventurer Airis was charmed by Ishuto's strength and became his guardian so he could enter the adventurer training school, but due to his otherworldly powers, he graduated the very first day, receiving the unprecedented title of "level 0". He's a maverick with Demon Lord powers that has no match in this world...

(Source: MANGA UP!)
synonyms: Level 0 Evil King Become the Adventurer in the New World

title.english: Level 0 Demon King Becomes an Adventurer in Another World
title.native: レベル0の魔王様、異世界で冒険者を始めます
title.romaji: Level 0 no Maou-sama, Isekai de Boukensha wo Hajimemasu

title.native: 瀬乃さんはまだ恋を知らない
title.romaji: Seno-san wa Mada Koi wo Shiranai

synonyms: Kuroiwa Medaka doesn't understand my cuteness

title.native: 黒岩メダカに私の可愛いが通じない
title.romaji: Kuroiwa Medaka ni Watashi no Kawaii ga Tsuujinai

title.native: 美少女捕獲して性教育

synonyms: Teaching a Beautiful Young Girl Sex-Ed via Hypnosis
C96 JCのおまけ(ごった煮)

127591.description:
Fu Ruan had to work very hard to pay off her huge debt. But thanks to her outstanding strength and perfect massage skills she was hired to work as a maid. Her new job was to take care of the prince who suffered injures at the war and help with his rehabilitation. She thought that her new employer would be a collected and mature man, but he turned out to be a sharp-tongued tsundere?! How will they cope with each other? And how soon will their employer-employee relationship become a blissful love story?

Note: The chapter count includes a prologue.

127592.description: Shen Zhongyi, an ordinary high school student, accidentally discovered that the girl he liked was an alien and also a staff member of the Galaxy Customer Service Department. The department responds to various incidents caused by tourists (aliens living on the earth), and "solve" the problem with the people who now are involved (delete memories, tamper with memories, and even destroy their bodies). In order to avoid being wiped out and losing the memory of getting along with her, Shen Zhongyi started a job career in the customer service department of the Galaxy, which came with a lot of danger.

127593.description:
Su-Yeon and I-Se first meet as sex partners through a dating app. However, Su-Yeon, who was once an easy-going man, starts to be sincere towards I-Se along the road, and suggests they have a relationship, but is flatly rejected by I-Se. Su-Yeon becomes worried after I-Se abruptly leaves the app. Even while Su-Yeon was preparing for "Bring Your Parents To School" Day at the school he taught, all he could think about was I-Se. But, ridiculously enough, I-Se comes as a parent of one of the students that he teaches.

Yet, what is this? He pretends to not know me?!

127594.description:
When presumed-beta Yoo Hansol visits the doctor for some concerning new symptoms, he’s surprised to discover that instead of dying, he’s actually an omega! Totally unused to the realities of being an omega, Hansol forgets his suppressants, starting a chain reaction he couldn’t possibly have imagined. Nearly passing out on school grounds, Hansol is quickly rushed to the school nurse by the hunky gym teacher. The thing is, at this stage, there’s only one way to soothe an omega in the throes of heat…and two oh-so-sexy alphas who are more than happy to help.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes six extra chapters.

127596.description: A battle between a girl who doesn't want to move from her haunted apartment and the ghosts who are desperate to haunt her and make her move away.

title.native: モノのケものぐらし 稲生物怪録異譚
title.romaji: Mononoke Mono Gurashi: Inaoi Mononokeroku Itan

127597.description:
A beautiful love story between a boy and a girl, that takes place in Hokkaido.

(Source: Naver, translated)

127598.description:
Considering herself to be a badass villain, Xiao Yixin doesn’t have the slightest interest in seeking redemption—not even when she’s in hell being sentenced.

“You are sentenced to be a good person in your next life. Now go and serve your term.”

This is how she ends up on the good men’s side and get her “good man”.

“Please don’t be mistaken! I…I…quenched the fire in your body just to complete my mission! There’s nothing unprofessional between us!”

(Source: MangaToon)

127599.description:
Ha On-Bit, a boy who suffered from heart problems after a car accident, has a dream where he is killed by an unidentified assailant. The relief of it being a dream only lasted for a moment, though, as On-Bit ran into that mysterious person exactly as it had happened in his dream. While he is running away, he comes to the realization that a deadly weapon that can destroy everything is inside his heart.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

127600.description: Four women, all college seniors. Their four loves, four lives.

127601.description:
Jae-Kyung, who grew up under a perfectionist father, must keep first place in the entire school.

(Source: Naver, translated)

127602.description:
Jun-Woo wakes up in the morning and next to him, in his natural state (?) is his sunbae?!! It’s true that they’re dating, and it’s great to see how enthusiastic sunbae is, but!! Isn’t this mature style of dating (?) too much? Caught between pure love and sexual love, are we fine like this, sunbae?

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

127603.description:
A lifetime of hard work has finally paid off for Se-Rin. She's got a nice apartment, a promotion at work, but something's missing. A piece of her that she's pushed away for so long that when it comes back, it beats faster and throbs harder than she could've ever imagined. Flings are for students and teenagers. She may be all grown up, but that doesn't mean she's ready for her first scandal.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Winner of the 2nd Lezhin Comics Big Comic Contest.
synonyms: ゴールドミス・スキャンダル

127605.description:
Ding Hanbai, a young master at a centuries-old jade-carving shop, bullies the timid Ji Zhenzhu at first, not expecting that someone from Jiangnan could break down his defenses and melts his heart. Over time, their admiration grows into a special affection, taking them one step closer to a lifetime together.

(Source: INKR)

127606.description:
The birth rate is falling sharply in 21st Century Japan. To combat the decreasing numbers, there's only one option left: get men pregnant. Yuki and Ryu are chosen to test a new drug that makes conceiving possible for men and are randomly paired up for the experiment. Yuki has to have sex with Ryu every day, even though he doesn't like him. However, the experiment has a condition: you can't leave the experiment until you give birth to a child. Reluctantly doing their best to get pregnant, Yuki and Ryu slowly start growing closer,but their time's running out! Then there's a new and embarrassing experiment with a loving couple, Ren and Rui, that gets them in the middle of even more embarrassing action! All this in gorgeous full-color!

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: オス♂ママ～妊娠できちゃった俺～

synonyms: High Diver in the Crash World

title.native: 墜落世界のハイダイバー
ガーゴイルおるたなてぃぶ
ガーゴイルおるたなてぃぶZERO
契約結婚～俺様社長の甘い罠～
title.romaji: Keiyaku Kekkon: Ore-sama Shachou no Amai Wana

127611.description: On the first day of high school, Yuuki Kousuke was killed while trying to help someone. However, that was not the end of his story. The old man he helped happened to be a god. As thanks, he lets Kousuke reincarnate into another world. He was overjoyed to live the life of those overpowered protagonists seen in his favorite isekai stories, however, when he came to, he found himself at the very same spot he died. This is the story of a protagonist living a peaceful life in the modern era with the cheat ability given to him by a god... not. The cat he ended up saving turned out to be a god too.

title.native: 異世界転生…されてねぇ!
鎖された古城と囚われの乙女
title.romaji: Tozasareta Kojou to Toraware no Otome

title.native: わたしの魔術コンサルタント
囚われの花嫁と甘い毒の鎖
title.romaji: Toraware no Hanayome to Amai Doku no Kusari

127617.description: Mimi, like many others, was born with animal ears. Nobody knows why is this but the society treat them like slaves. Kujo, an aristocrat, becomes fascinated with Mimi and decides to keep her.

127618.description:
Ra-On can’t stand men, and he’s determined to stay away from them at all costs. Little does he know that the shy, soft-spoken Seo-U is crushing on him hard. So hard, in fact, that he’s recruited his more confident twin brother, Je-U, to act as his double and approach Ra-On. After being killed by a passing robber, a normal 37-year-old guy finds himself reincarnated as Kousaku Shima in 1984.

127728.description: Reiji Kiryu, the most gifted student their school has ever seen, turns down Akira's childhood friend, Momoka, when she asks him out. Akira, a self-admitted delinquent, vows to beat his ass into the ground in retribution and calls him out after school... but!! After being hypnotized in front of a crowd, Akira is helpless to resist as Reiji brings him to ecstasy with a single touch of his finger...! As Reiji's hypnotism steadily escalates, sooner or later... Akira might really become his woman...!

A collection of oneshots which were published in Shuukan Shonen Jump.

1. Mysterious Kid
2. SYNCHRONICITY
3. JUMPIN'JACK FLASH
4. Bachi-Atari Rock

Note: The premises of the last three titles would lead to the creation of Rokudenashi Blues.

127730.description: Laid off from his job as a chef, Hidenao Kanohara decided to visit Kyoto to take his mind off things. While touring an inari shrine, he became lost in the woods and found himself taken to the kitsune village where young fox spirits live. When he saw the kits eating instant noodles, Kanohara was inspired to cook up some real food. The kitsune loved it so much that they convinced him to stay to cook for them. But the presence of a human in the spirit realm caused an unexpected twists in the space-time!
synonyms: 小狐狸們開飯嘍! 稻荷神的員工餐

title.native: こぎつね、わらわら　稲荷神のまかない飯　いただきますっ！
title.romaji: Kogitsune, Warawara: Inarishin no Makanai Meshi Itadakimasutsu!

127731.description:
After graduating high school, Shinobu hasn’t been able to get a job. One day, he wins a lottery. He uses the prize he wins to move to another world and starts a new life.

Using his cheat skill with plants, he’ll enjoy a relaxing, slow life!

Anyway, as long as he won’t have problems with food, he’s not going to complain.

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

福引で当たったので異世界に移住してみました
Fukubiki de Atatta no de Isekai ni Ijuu Shite Mimashita

127733.description:
A light and sweet romance story of a resolute yet affectionate boss and his cute and light-hearted assistant. Love with its joys and hassles can turn even the boring office work into an exciting romantic adventure!

(Source: Aloha Comics)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

127734.description:
In an attempt to save a child from a wild beast, skilled hunter Shin Nakajima was killed by a bear. But a goddess has summoned him to another world–along with his prized Remington Model 870 shotgun! Nakajima was a member of his local hunters’ association back on Earth, but it’s going to take more than standard skills to protect himself from the fantasy creatures in this place. Enter the beautiful elf Saran, who swiftly comes to his aid: she towers over him, is an elite hunter in this environment, and has a sweet nature that instantly attracts Nakajima. The feeling is mutual, so this unlikely pair is about to become a power couple in the fantasy wild!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: An Active Hunter in Hokkaido Has Been Thrown into a Different World

title.english: Hunting in Another World With My Elf Wife
title.native: 北海道の現役ハンターが異世界に放り込まれてみた ～エルフ嫁と巡る異世界狩猟ライフ～

title.romaji: Osananajimi no Jidou Hanbaiki ni Proposal shita Keii ni Tsuite.

127736.description: A woman was looking at him from outside his window. His room was at second floor.

127738.description:
Sophia Lenish, a baron’s daughter, was eventually kicked out of her aunt’s home after her fiance breaks their engagement in favor of Sophia’s cousin.

Having exhausted her tears and strength after walking with nowhere to go, Sophia falls alseep in the middle of the forest. When she awakens, she has a sword held to her throat!?

“You should live by my side.”

“But I… will just be a burden.”

This is the sweet, sweet, romantic story about regaining what was lost, focusing on the magic knight, Marquis Gilbert Forster, who is called the “Black Knight”, and Sophia, who was picked up by him.
127738.hashtag: #捨てられ男爵令嬢は黒騎士様のお気に入り

title.native: 捨てられ男爵令嬢は黒騎士様のお気に入り
title.romaji: Suterare Danshaku Reijou wa Kurokishi-sama no Okiniiri

127739.description:
Carrying the baggage of the adventurers and in addition to other miscellaneous tasks in the guild… veteran adventurer Baru is known as a dowdy man who only does simple jobs, but he feels satisfied to live as such in the capital city. “I’m counting on you today too, Mr. Baru!” “Sure, I’d be glad to.” Be it the receptionist working at the guild or the people on the streets, they were all endeared by his friendliness and helpfulness, but they did not know—that he was in fact one of the “Eight Glories”, the one with the greatest strength, Bartholomeus. “Shall we go then, Lord Baru.” With the elf beauty who only trust in him as his follower, his is truly the War-God who rules over both politics and warfare.

(Source: KADOKAWA, translated)
synonyms: That Ordinary Mister Is a War God
A Normally Dowdy Man Is in Essence the Mightiest War-God.

title.native: 日常ではさえないただのおっさん、本当は地上最強の戦神
title.romaji: Nichijou dewa Saenai Tada no Ossan, Hontou wa Chijou Saikyou no Senshin

127740.description:
Claire Martino has a fairy-tale life anyone would envy, with a noble upbringing, a crown prince for a fiancé, and a promising future ahead of her as Noston’s most powerful mage. That is, until everything crashes down around her when all of the family magical talent goes to her half sister, Charlotte, instead. With her engagement broken and reputation tarnished, Claire flees the only life she’s ever known and sets off on an adventure to find the freedom she’s craved all along. It’s anything but easy, but fortunately for a girl with dignity, talent, and a whole lot of bravery, nothing is impossible...even turning out to be a video game character! Much to her surprise, Claire finds herself periodically teleported to modern-day Tokyo where Claire Martino is no more than a side character in the classic dating sim game Upstart: Eternal Love. Yet even that won’t stop Claire from saving the day so she can unlock the good ending of her own route.

(Source: J-Novel Club)
synonyms: Formerly, The Fallen Daughter of the Duke

title.english: Formerly, the Fallen Daughter of the Duke
title.native: 元、落ちこぼれ公爵令嬢です。

127741.description:
Marriage Royale's story revolves around the male protagonist, a high school student named Tsukasa Hinomoto, who is told one day by his parents that he was adopted. Furthermore, they tell him that his real father is a manager of a large company, meaning he is very rich and holds a lot of power. Tsukasa's real father wants his son to marry a good woman, so he sets up an event known as Marriage Royale where beautiful girls from all over Japan will come together at a school built especially for the event and vie to become Tsukasa's fiancée. The school is located on an isolated island near Japan, and Tsukasa himself is taken there to live in a mansion in the care of two twin maids: Miku, the elder sister, and Miu, the younger sister.

(Source: Wikipedia)

title.native: トラックに轢かれたのに異世界転生できないと言われたから、美少女と働くことにした。
title.romaji: Truck ni Hikareta no ni Isekai Dekinai to Iwareta kara, Bishoujo to Hataraku Koto ni Shita.

127744.description:
Yukimura Rina is an overworked twenty-something systems engineer who's dangerously close to her breaking point. Her only comfort is an otome game with a charming side character, the brother of the villainess, who soothes her weary heart. She gets so hooked that she forgoes sleep and ends up blacking out...only to wake up inside the game as the villainess, Ekaterina.

She's now the little sister of her favorite character! Her new brother Alexei is handsome, kind, and responsible—the whole package. Rina, now Ekaterina, would be happy just staying by his side, except for one little problem. If she allows the game to run its course, she and her brother are headed straight for a terrible future! Can Ekaterina overcome the doom flags that threaten her new family and the empire, while also preventing Alexei from working himself to death?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

127747.description: This story tells the life of two people, a noble only in name and an older wife from the army, married on a tentative agreement. In the bone-chilling cold, they spend their time hunting, gutting, and cooking by the fireplace. Their daily life passes peacefully. This is the warm love story recounting it.

127749.description: After losing his mother at an early age Mizushima dedicates his life to studying and pursuing the goal of creating a flower that would never wilt. One day, after meeting Hanamori, a florist from a nearby flower shop, his perspective on life begins to change.

title.native: サキュバステードライフ 現代淫魔との同棲事情
title.romaji: Succubus Stayed Life: Gendai Inma to no Dousei Jijou

127752.description:
A healer gets booted from his party because the leader notices he isn't really contributing much to the team. Soon enough, the healer must look for new members to party with. After finding a cute martial artist to work together with, he reveals his secret: while he's a fairly mediocre healer, he actually fights well in close combat. This is the story of a support who's secretly a DPS, and where the entire conflict stems from the fact that he never told his old party he was a DPS.

(Source: Manga Mirai)
synonyms: The Healer Who Was Banished From His Party, Is, in Fact, the Strongest

title.english: The Healer Who Was Banished From His Party, Is, in Fact, the Strongest

127755.description:
My first love childhood friend is back as a zombie!?

Tamaki, a girl who died in an accident, became a zombie and crawled out of the grave to convey her feelings to her childhood friend. Shin, a lonely high school boy, remains confused by the fierce attack of Tamaki...!

A surreal romantic comedy!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 幼馴染みが還ってきました

127756.description:
Miura is an ordinary healthy high school boy madly in love with his girlfriend Kare-chan. But Kare-chan is totally sheltered and innocent, so Miura has to always act like a considerate gentleman, even if he wants to hold her hand so very badly. It's an agonizingly cute love comedy about a doting boy's battle between instinct and reason!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

127764.description:
College students went to a tunnel in the mountains in order to livestream a test of courage... where they are attacked by giant insects! A brutal survival story of giant insects vs. humans!!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

127765.description: A short story about a female aspiring singer to follow her grandfathers footsteps and an angel who follow the orders of his father an elder angel who met female singers grandfather when he was young.

127766.description:
Meet Yoshida. He's cool, he's smart, and he's really, really good-looking. He's the company superstar, and has the eye of every available woman for miles around. But Yoshida only loves one woman—the manga-artist and walking-disaster Sena Shimakaze. Yoshida is the glue that holds her whole team together and helps them limp through each and every deadline...but despite his personal greatness and obvious management skills, his love is somehow totally one-sided. What's an overachiever like Yoshida to do?

(Source: Kodansha USA)
synonyms: The Transcendent One-Sided Love of Yoshida the Catch

title.english: The Transcendent One-Sided Love of Yoshida the Catch
title.native: 超絶片思いハイスペック吉田

127767.description:
In 2011, Swedish comics artist and illustrator Åsa Ekström moved to Japan to try to establish herself as a comics creator in the native land of manga. After many years of hard labor, she broke through with a web diary in comic form, which quickly grew enormously popular. In a series of short, humorous, and insightful comic strips, Åsa touches upon many of Japan's wonderful, different, and sometimes inscrutable facets, as they may be experienced from the perspective of a Westerner.

(Source: Kartago, translated)
synonyms: Nordic Girl Åsa Discovers the Mysteries of Japan
Mitt liv i Japan: En svensk mangatecknares bekännelser

title.native: 北欧女子オーサが見つけた日本の不思議
title.romaji: Hokuou Joshi Åsa ga Mitsuketa Nihon no Fushigi

127771.description: ''I can never make Sora have a child…''

The Person Who Cheers The People Who Try.
The Person Who Cheers The People Who Try

127775.description: When Tamaki's parents died and left her penniless in college, Takafuji-senpai took her in and helped her with everything from tuition to a place to live. Despite his love and affection, Tamaki decided to leave him, feeling herself unworthy to be his equal. Until three years later, Takafuji suddenly appeared, and asks her to become his mistress!?

127776.description:
It's an eromergency!!!

(Source: Fakku!)

Published in Comic X-Eros #87

127777.description:
Sora Mishima is a sunny and kind-hearted high school girl who would like to have a boyfriend. One day, she has a rather sexy dream and comes to school to find a transfer student, Akane Kamidate, has arrived in her class. He looks like a gloomy, dark-skinned guy, but for some reason, everyone in the class seems to be attracted to him...?

(Source: Shonen Jump Plus, translated)

title.native: 陰気なアイツは半キュバス

127778.description:
I'm the only one who knows the true face of the popular girl, Sekime-san! Thus begins the romantic comedy between my overly shy girlfriend and I!

Note: Includes extra chapters 3.5, 4.5, 14.5, and 24.5.
synonyms: อย่าหน้าแดงสิครับคุณเซคิเมะ

title.native: 赤面しないで関目さん

127779.description:
Natsumi’s got a bad habit of picking on girls, so his big sister decides to teach him a lesson… by turning him into a girl!

(Source: Fakku!)

title.english: Tiny Little Bro, Huge Big Sis
title.native: ちっちゃい弟おっきい姉

127780.description:
Ichigo was once a popular detective that used his good looks as a weapon. However, now that he’s completely worn out, he is in needy circumstances… A man named Kuki Otohide then requests his services. Ichigo is enthusiastic about the reward, since it’s been a while for him. Unfortunately, he fails, after all, his client had to help him out. However, there was something Kuki wanted to check with Ichigo, so he suddenly pressed him for… what?!

(Source: Core Magazine, translated)

title.native: レッドリスト 絶滅進化論

127782.description:
This sweet, popular yaoi novel has finally been turned into a manga! "You were the one who tempted me." Caesar, the second-in-command with blond hair and blue eyes, has been cold to Louie, who works as a doctor at the front-line base, since they first met. Caesar's unreasonable hostility annoys Louie, but in an unexpected turn of events, they start sharing a room. Louie knows of Caesar's resentment towards him, but his strong body turns him on while they lie next to each other. He opens his shirt a little to push his body against Caesar's...... An eternal romance begins in a locked space. Sweet fantasy yaoi between a blue-eyed knight with blond hair and a military base doctor!

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: From the Front-Line Base with Love
title.native: 前線基地から愛を込めて
title.romaji: Zensen Kichi Kara Ai wo Komete

127783.description:
On his deathbed, the supreme dark leader is given an ironic second chance at life. He’s reborn as Jin-Mu, a young disciple of his rival clan, the righteous Mudang. Determined to make the best of a bad situation, he resolves to plunge the clan into corruption and debauchery by becoming their master disciple. Oblivious to this nefarious scheme, the Mudang begin to fall for Jin-Mu's audacious approach to life and martial arts. Will Jin-Mu be the Mudang Clan’s downfall or just the kick in the pants it needs?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

127784.description:
Reborn after a betrayal that cost her life and her unborn child, Tianqing seizes her second chance, not just for revenge but to ascend the entertainment industry's heights. Her path crosses with President Tang, an unexpected and overbearing figure in her new life. When he offers her a lavish life in marriage, she boldly rejects him, declaring her own power and independence. This is her journey of empowerment and fame, where she defies expectations and reshapes her destiny.

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: Reborn To Be A Movie Queen

127785.description:
When a your royal reached adulthood, there is secretive pink room where he is brought and a rite of passage is performed. The young man is not kept privy to the ritual in advance. On the day of his birthday, our protagonist is brought to the pink room. To his shock, what awaits him there is the sweet scent lingering in the air and a beautiful elf girl bound to a bed. The ritual may start...

(Source: Fakku!)

title.english: The Pink Room and the Nighttime Pot
title.native: 紅絹色の部屋と夜の壺
title.romaji: Momiiro no Heya to Yoru no Tsubo

127786.description:
Being forced to get married, she is really confused. What’s more confusing is that he isn’t willing either! He forced her to quit, but he also touched her head to comfort her when he said too much. Those sweet moments are like illusions. The moment when she decides to put an end to everything because of tiredness, however, she was won back by him with the words, "take responsibility for him"... What does he want?

(Source: Webcomics)
synonyms: A Doting Marriage Dropped From the Clouds

127787.description:
Asako and Yuko are futanari wives who think about sex 24/7. Luckily for them, they might have found a new fuck toy who can keep up with the two of them!

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title.native: ふたなり主婦のオナホ

127788.description:
Before she was reborn, she was bullied by her step mother and her scoundrel sister together, and even became a her sister’s tool of fame who ended in dying in the hospital bed. After she made her comeback from the hell, she tortured her step mother and punished her evil sister. In her previous life, she was driven anguished and desperate by her indifferent fiance, but after she was reborn, she issued an annulment of her engagement with that man! However, she was directly forced to the corner ——Wanna pull back? It’s too late!

(Source: Webcomics)

127789.description: There’s more to being in the swim team than just swimming, especially if your girlfriend happens to be as hot as Sayaka. Let’s just be thankful that all that aerobic exercise pays of for all of the sweet, sweet sex that comes with it.

title.native: さやかさんとひと泳ぎ 総集編

127790.description:
In my previous life, I was forced to cultivate for a hundred years by a ruthless empress. I severed my soul just to escape from that tiger's den! In this life, I'll learn all the martial arts and soul techniques so that I can change this perilous world!

(Source: Bilibili Comics, translated)
synonyms: Does Your Mother Need Son In Low

title.romaji: Ben Xu Xiu de Shi Jian Dao

title.native: ステージ・オブ・ザ・グラウンド
あまあねハーレム 四姉妹と無人島!?
title.romaji: Ama ne Harem: Yonshimai to Mujintou!?

127794.description:
Being a prince who died fighting on the battlefield a thousand years ago, he woke up in modern times and encountered his former imperial concubine to whom he’s indebted. He thought he could make up for regrets in this life, but a fake concubine appeared. This time, will the tragedy go on, or will he find the real her?

(Source: Webcomics)

title.english: My Mr. Right is a Zombie

127795.description:
June Qin was forced to marry an idiot on her cousin's behalf in order to help her aunt repay an enormous debt. Who would've thought the idiot's older brother would be the one to appear at the wedding ceremony. He was the third generation heir to the Zong Family, Michael Zong. "You're finally in my hands, I won't let you go." Michael Zong forcibly married his younger brother's fiancee in order to take revenge against the humiliation he faced when he was a kid. Who will be the first to fall in this mismatched marriage, and how will this preposterous beginning come to a satisfactory end?!

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Ti Jia Xinniang De Gonglüe Jihua

synonyms: My Uncle and I Choose the Life That Will Not Be Ruined

title.native: 転生叔父さまと私の軌道修正ライフ
title.romaji: Tensei Oji-sama to Watashi no Kidou Shuusei Life

title.native: とりぷるM クラスメイトは放課後ドレイ!?
title.romaji: Triple M: Classmate wa Houkago Dorei!?

127803.description:
Self-made lawyer Yukitoshi Nakaso is reunited with Tomoe Gojou, his former college classmate, in court. After being headhunted by the law firm's director, Tomoe begins working at the same firm as Yukitoshi. However, after drinking too much at the welcoming party, they return to their office together, where Tomoe passionately gazes at Yukitoshi and makes advances on him. Unable to control himself, Yukitoshi bends Tomoe over and things escalate from there.
Can love save the man chained down by his past? This is an office love story between a self-made man and a beautiful son from a rich family who is afraid to love!

(Source: Renta!)

Note: The series was first serialized as "Raku no Otoko" and later compiled under the title "Aishite Hoshii to Ittekure".

The distant future. Invaders from another world attack without warning, unleashing a new type of threat: weapons known as "machine lifeforms." In the face of this insurmountable threat, mankind is driven from Earth and takes refuge on the Moon.

It is the year 11941, and the long war against the machines rages on. In an attempt to break the deadlock, the Council of Humanity forms a new infantry unit of female androids: YoRHa. Deployed to the planet’s surface, these soldiers now fight to recapture Earth for the glory of mankind…

(Source: MANGA UP!)

127813.description:
“There are no sane men left in this world. They're like ghosts, mimicking their past behaviors and assaulting any woman they see. They've turned into beasts.”

Anezaki Satoru had a precious childhood friend, Ichinose Yuna, who was killed by a gang of rapists. Blinded by rage and thirst for revenge, Satoru gruesomely murdered 15 rapists and cut off their genitals, for which he was sentenced to capital punishment. After his death, Satoru regains consciousness in another world where all men have become mindless beasts. Finding himself lost in this world, he meets some of the struggling survivors fighting the hordes of beasts. What he learns is shocking... Yuna is apparently still alive in this world! Satoru chooses to join the fight in order to find his precious friend.

(Source: Comikey)

Welcome to Screengrab, the ultimate app for succubi to extract essence from all kinds of men! Capturing and breaking in a man has never been easier, and the view has never been this good. Take a front row seat to watch loner succubus Sola conquer a whole collection of men as she delves into their deepest, darkest desires in this steamy comic from the creator of "S Flower".

(Source: Lezhin)

127819.description:
Is Kira's story truly over, or does his influence linger?

In this complete collection of Death Note short stories penned by the series' creators, discover tales of lives irrevocably changed by the sinister influence of the Death Note, with surprising and thrilling answers to the question of what it truly takes to use the Death Note... or fight it.

Contains stories "C-Kira," "a-Kira," the Death Note pilot chapter, vignettes of L's life, and more.

(Source: VIZ Media)

127820.description:
If anyone’s looking for proof that two people can have casual sex and stay friends, look no further than Choi Eui-hyun and Jung Min. First classmates, and now co-workers, the secret ingredient to this 9-year relationship may just be Min’s unique preferences in bed. As someone who has never needed a safe word for anything in his life, Eui-hyun often struggles with Min’s overwhelming demands. Min, on the other hand, sometimes feels frustrated by how much convincing Eui-hyun needs to get kinky with him. But they’ve already lasted nine years, so what’s nine more…right? Or will their differences ultimately drive them apart?

(Source: Lezhin US)

127821.description:
She was pushed to a man with extremely mysterious identity. After she was intimate with him, she had no choice but to run away during pregnancy. A few years later, she showed up with her son, Bao! As a little man, the biggest dream of Bao is to help his mom find a perfect husband who should be the richest man in the world with a height of 1.99 meters and 8 abs for his mother! “Mom, what do you think of this man?” added Bao，pointing his finger at the man who seemed to be a plus size version of himself. “Woman, you’ve escaped for a long time, it’s time to come back and make an apology!” The man appeared aggressively! As a result, Lin Zhi lost not only her son, but also her heart!

(Source: WebComics)

127822.description:
A shy returning student who loves caring for flowers, Hyunwoo has a condition that makes him pass out in the presence of excessive stimuli. For example, he nearly fainted at a bar recently because of some freshman who’d doused himself in cologne. Thankfully, he got some fresh air in time, as well as a glimpse of that same freshman making out with another guy. Hyunwoo doesn’t think much of it, but a few days later, he’s overwhelmed by the same dizzying yet irresistible scent. But this time, he’s not at a bar—he’s at a flower-themed cafe, to interview for a job he desperately wants and needs. What will Hyunwoo find in this garden of memories?

(Source: Lezhin)

127823.description:
Once a haughty princess, now a lowly maid! Humiliated and abused, she refused to give up in the face of a cruel and unforgiving reality. As she climbs her way back up using her unparalleled wits, will she be able to reclaim everything that was once hers?

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Note: Chapter count includes two bonus chapters.

127824.description:
A secret office romance between the son of the CEO of a huge conglomerate and his newbie secretary slash perpetual liar! Yeonju gave up her career in order to chase after love, but only found herself left with scars and pain…After getting a position at a huge company as a secretary, she finds herself face-to-face with her new boss, Jaehyun, who also happens to be a former classmate of Yeonju’s! Jaehyun’s serious good looks and short temper earned him the nickname among his employees, “the S.H.B.”, or the “super, handsome bastard”.

After a series of humiliating situations, Jaehyun admits that he no longer just wants to be friends, and would rather date. Yeonju, who had her mind set on never dating ever again, finds herself interested despite how hard she tries not to fall for him!

(Source: NetComics)

127825.description:
Is it a good or bad idea to have your ideal type as your bodyguard? Young bestselling author Han Jae-Hwa is about to find out. With three hit novels and a slew of film adaptations, not to mention a flood of media attention for his chic good looks, Jae-Hwa seems to have everything going for him…but fame comes at a price. After a stalker breaks into his home, Jae-Hwa decides to hire a bodyguard for some inner peace. Seong Tae-Kyung is seasoned and capable, everything you’d want in a bodyguard. The only problem is that he’s way too hot, and Jae-Hwa can’t keep his eyes off him. Hounded both by a stalker and by his own turbulent feelings, Jae-Hwa must face not only the enemies of his past but also his own longstanding intimacy issues with Tae-Kyung's help.

(Source: Lezhin US)

127826.description:
He was all alone, until he found his savior...

Rei has eternal life by feeding on the energy of other beings. He's not human and the only way for him to become mortal is to find his "soulmate"... As all of his fellow beings find their partners and die along with them, he's been alone now for hundreds of years without ever finding his soulmate. But, when he meets the wealthy and carefree Yuto, Rei begins to feel something that he's never felt before...

(Source: Renta!)

127827.description:
"From today, I want you to work on making a baby." Shun is brave and hard-working, and has the strength to rebel against being born as an omega. That's because of his two alpha best friends: the masculine and strong-willed Kiyohisa and the handsome and intellectual Haruto. Their friendship was irreplaceable to Shun, but secretly he has always been in love with Kiyohisa... One day, he came home only to be informed, "You're betrothed to Haruto now." This is going to mess up their friendship, and his feelings for Kiyohisa!! This love triangle plus forced pregnancy... what does destiny have in store for them in this dramatic omega-verse!?

(Source: Renta!)

127829.description: It's every high school baseball team's dream to go to the legendary Koshien Stadium Tournament. For the first time in years, Seido High School has a chance—star player Gorilla Matsui has finally given the team an opportunity to succeed. Most delighted at this prospect is Principal Kocho. However, the Head teacher reveals to him that the first game will be played against the Gedo High School, infamous for brutally killing all their opponents. Kocho instantly loses all hope, both for his students' lives and of winning the tournament.

Ten years later, her careful plan plays out, as she catches the eye of second-prince Ran Zhao. The lady spy walks a knife's edge, as a conspiracy unfolds… See how she reverses her fortune and rises from the ashes…

Jaekyung, who has a hard time forming deep relationships with people, takes charge of the remodeling project for an amusement park and hotel enterprise. While taking a look around the park to gain a better understanding for the project, he comes across lighthearted Taehee who is dressed as a bear mascot, and is drawn to him despite not wanting to be. Taehee approaches the typically detached Jaekyung, and proposes a no-strings-attached relationship for the two to enjoy. However...

127845.description:
“Koinosuke! If you lose, the Kanda as we know it will be lost forever!!”

In post-war Japan, a government-funded program of organized violence called the "Tokyo Loop Line Duels" is promoted to maintain law and order—and it works. Representatives from each station on the Yamanote line battle for control of their territory. Any defeat could mean losing family members, friends, money—or worse. Fast-forward to now, in 2020; a new station has opened up. Everyone, including the popular rookie, Koinosuke, is itching to join the fray for the top spot. Will he be victorious? Or will violence consume them all?

(Source: Comikey)

127847.description:
Twenty-one year old Yuna is tired of having guys hit on her all the time. As popular as she is, she's been single her whole life. Just when she decides to make herself a boyfriend to fend off guys, she meets a handsome guy who looks good enough to be her boyfriend. But wait, the guy is actually a girl! In fact, rumor says that Min is a lesbian. Nonetheless, the two decide to pretend to be in a romantic relationship.

(Source: Pocket Comics)

127848.description:
A young orphan was alone in the world until he meets the master of a secret form of martial arts. To learn these otherworldly techniques, he will need to endure years of his sadistic teacher’s grueling and weird training. But why does he have to do laundry, cook meals, or play instruments to learn martial arts anyway?! If he can survive long enough (and if his massive ego doesn’t get in the way), he just might be able to wield the unstoppable lightning knives. Will he make the cut or be sliced down to size?

127861.description:
“I, Yuri Hiroto, have apparently turned into a pervert. I’ve been having dirty dreams lately—about getting groped by sea creatures! And even worse, these dreams include someone staring at me during my filthy fish time: the marine biology nerd from my class, Ogasawara-kun! The guy is so obsessed with undersea life that honestly, he kinda weirded me out at first. But now that I’m deep in the closet pretending to be “normal,” I think it’s attractive that he can be true to himself without caring what people think. Of course, the moment I realized I like him, my dreams became even more obscene! Cut to our hang-out at the aquarium, and while I’m looking at fish with Ogasawara-kun, I actually get turned on?! Seriously, what is wrong with me?!”

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

127862.description:
Yurae and Muwon used to be all business because they were in an arranged marriage until Yurae asked for a divorce. She moved out of the country and returned three years later for a brief work trip. She’s different now and more confident in how she lives her life. But fate—and Muwon—won’t let her get away that easily. Now that she has to oversee her company’s deal with Muwon, will it be easy for them to separate their business and private lives and leave the past behind?

(Source: Tapas)

Blondina is living a real-life Cinderella story. After growing up poor and enduring a difficult childhood, she discovers that she is a princess of the Ates empire. However, her estranged father and half-siblings give her the cold shoulder when she moves into the palace, and Blondina must keep a low profile. That all changes when she befriends Amon, a cat-like creature with mysterious intentions. For years, creatures like Amon and humans have struggled to live in harmony. Can Blondina and Amon’s friendship bring peace, or will it deepen the rift between their people?

(Source: WEBTOON)

127871.description:
“This world is actually an otome game.”

On a certain day, Shiori was told an outrageous fact by her cousin, Kazuto. It turns out he has memories of his past life and his little sister then had played this certain otome game. The heroine in the game would capture hot-looking guys one after another in the school Shiori’s attending. And it turns out Kazuto was one of the capture targets! He asks Shiori to stop the heroine from capturing him.

From then on, Shiori runs left and right in the academy since the very first day, searching for the heroine’s whereabouts and her next movement. However, it seems Shiori is also triggering events one after another just like the heroine…!?

127872.description:
Her destination of reincarnation was not the villainess of an otome game, but her mother…

“Violet has been in love with her childhood friend, and was half-forced by her parents to marry him. However, she was not loved by him. Ever since their daughter was born, he rarely came back home. One day, he brought back back home the daughter of his mistress. She was very lovely and her age only differed a year from their daughter’s. Violet hated her step-daughter who was loved by everyone. With her daughter’s help, Violet started to bully her, in the end, it resulted in her daughter’s engagement being broken and she divorced her husband. They were then exiled to the countryside as a result.”

… Wait. Wasn’t I the one who raised her own daughter as a villainess?!

Violet is now 10 years old and since I know everything, I shall try my best to avoid this ending!”

After regaining consciousness, Yuuan realizes his injury on his foot but also a herb remedy curing it. But who did this? An oni named Akemaru tells Yuuan that he’s the one treating his injury. But how? An oni is a terrifying youkai that attacks and devours humans. Nonetheless, Yuuan and Akemaru decide to travel together. But at the end of the day the oni needs his “meal.”

I was reincarnated into a horrifying world. That is… the world of the otome game “I’ll Risk Everything for You”.

In that world I was reincarnated as the hidden love interest character, and decided to never involve myself with the Heroine. My head gets all screwed up whenever I’m around them.

Rachel only became the fiancée of the Prince due to her high magic power. That’s why when the Saint appeared, she feared that her position would be taken away from her.

As a punishment for her vile deed against the Saint, her engagement was annulled and she was banished to the monastery. But on the way to the monastery, she was attacked by bandits. Just as Rachel thought she was about to die, she suddenly woke up and found out that she had returned to three years ago.

However, she no longer had her high magic power and became so sickly that she could hardly even sit up in her bed. Rachel was just happy that she was alive and decided to cancel the engagement; yet for some reason, the Prince refused!?

This is the tale of the humble accountant, Kondou, who accompanied her and his trials and woes as he accounts in a new world... But no tale is complete without a love interest. And who better to play that role than the handsome knight captain Aresh? Will he begin a personal quest to save said bean counter—who toils around the clock—or is Kondou doomed to be married to his work evermore...?!

127893.description:
Yuji is an artist working out of a modest Tokyo apartment, when he suddenly receives a letter from his mother informing—not asking—him about an Italian girl coming to live with him while she attends university. Supposedly the two have a history, but forgotten memories lend little in the way of preparing either party for the inevitable awkwardness to come. Left with little say in the matter, Yuji’s bachelorhood comes to an end, and his life with Francesca begins.

(Source: J-Novel Club)

127906.description:
It has been six months since his beloved wife suddenly passed away. Manabu Shiratori, 45, who must now do most of the housework, is still struggling to lead a "normal" daily life. He wonders if he will ever be able to move on. While Manabu is still harboring these vague fears, something completely unexpected happens!

This is the start of a slapstick "life of the lost" story, in which the "lives of those who are left behind" are examined!

127909.description: Chihiro Wamura is an unassuming otaku girl who happens to sit next to Kaname Rutou, the beautiful honor student. They don't have anything in common, until one day Rutou-san asked Wamura to take a selfie with her while in class?

127910.description:
In the Forest of Scraps, a place where all manner of things are discarded, an old dragon sleeps away his final days—that is, until an abandoned child suddenly appears before him. The tiny human is Eve, and despite being only five years of age, she has somehow endured the many dangers that surround them. In an act of pity, the dragon decides to raise her as his own...but his time is still running out.

After five years together, he takes his last breath, leaving his precious daughter on her own. Little does the dragon know, Eve is capable of more than he realizes, and their reunion may be sooner than he thinks…

(Source: J-Novel Club)

127913.description: In the Land of Twelve Gods, everyone has a social class corresponding to an animal, and everyone is able to transform into their class animal at will. The young rabbit girl Rikka is married to the wolf-man Tooma, and the two are madly in love. He is a member of the wolf guards who uphold the law in the Land. This is the story of this happy couple and their adventures.

127914.description:
A boy was raised by his "Aunt" into a fine young man. He thought they would have the same relationship forever. But one day he sees something he shouldn't have, and their lives will never be the same again.

(Source: TOPTOON+)

127916.description:
When Crown Prince Vincent announces their engagement is over, Elizabeth faints. What will become of House la Montlivere? Of her entire family? At the prince’s side, the so-called heroine smirks. Elizabeth is doomed to a villainess’ fate… Only for the tables to turn when Vincent suddenly calls out the heroine for her misdeeds!

Jump into the story of an ill-fated but handsome prince as he fights for his darling fiancée, deflecting every attempt to turn her into an evildoer by any means necessary! They’ll have their lovey-dovey happily ever after, even if it kills him!

(Source: Cross Infinite World)

127917.description:
When she was a young girl, a Viscount’s daughter named Chloe was taken in by the bewitching words of the beautiful Sophia, daughter of a Count.

From then on, she enjoyed being her loyal crony, even if she had to endure a few pointed words every now and again, but…

Once Sophia’s fiance ends up betraying her, things completely flipped on their head?! In order to help her survive her predicament, Chloe sets her mind to finding Lady Sophia a new fiancee, with the help of Sophia’s sickly brother Austin.
synonyms: As the Villainess’ Final Crony, I’ll Follow Her to the End!

127919.description:
Apparently, this looks like the fantasy world from the Otome game that I used to play in my previous life. “I”, Altrea, am the lively rival character who challenged the heroine again and again until she/I received painful backlashes. Like only chasing to have the engagement canceled in the Magic Academy, even breaking and taking over the Duke’s house. For all these eventful stuff, please just give me a break! Or should I say the heart of the game’s heroine is too scarily impregnable! Living differently with the game’s knowledge? Dating the love interests in real life is super troublesome, so I refuse!

And so my main priority is to definitely not get involved. I will absolutely not go to that academy. I will go to a different country. Living as a Magic Doll Master in a new land is the best way to live. Eh- The Mystic-eyed Doll Princess? Queen Mage of the Netherworld? Even though I seriously tried my best, I have changed class into the last boss. Why!? Wait for a second, It’s a misunderstanding, Stop, forgive me-.

127922.description:
Koichi is a struggling young man whose dream is to live a peaceful life. He lives on his own, works two jobs, and he certainly isn't rich, but he's happy with the way things stand. One day, Koichi is on his way home from his shift at the convenience store when he comes across Reiji, a good-looking yet unfriendly regular customer, trying to help an abandoned kitten in the pouring rain. Somehow, Koichi and Reiji end up taking care of the kitten together...!! What will happen to Koichi's peaceful life!? The opening episode of a comedy story about a struggling worker with muscle, a cool but clumsy rich kid in college, and a cat.

(Source: Renta!)

127924.description: Lost in his world of carving, Sakura is resigned to being a social outcast. That is, until Izuka enters his life.

127926.description:
Haru and Kai are childhood friends, and their friendship is stronger than most. Haru likes hanging out with girls?? they're cute, they're soft, and they smell good. But at the same time, he feels most at ease hanging out with Kai. One day, Haru stumbles upon Kai getting off while he calls Haru's name. Shocked at what he has seen, he becomes oddly intrigued with Kai. Two high school boys: an eligible bachelor and an outgoing pretty boy. A bittersweet story of a glittering young romance and more is about to unfold!

(Source: Renta!)

127927.description:
After being unfairly framed in devildom, middle-tier devil Sitri falls onto Earth as a human and searches for a serial killer who could take him back to his origin. He meets a stubborn, strict human boss who he initially hates; however, he eventually starts having feelings for her. Love has no limits, but... does it really? What will be their fate?

But for modern-day succubi like her who can feed off of human feelings of embarrassment instead of sucking out their life essence directly, things become dire when her boy-toy tries to give her the cold shoulder due to upcoming exams. Will he be able to say no to the plan she's got cooked up for him though?

When Yanaka is reunited with his childhood friend Sakura Mandagi again in high school, things start to get frisky when she reminisces about old times.

When I woke up after collapsing from overwork working for a black company, I had been reborn as the son of a minor feudal lord in a different world. Our lands were attacked by monsters, I lost my new parents, and the people fleed... In order to survive, I must gather a talented elite so this land can thrive by employing my knowledge from my past life as a overworked white-collar worker! A story of managing a fiefdom in another world starting from zero citizens!

(Source: Manga UP!)

"Cocoa" has made three best friends in her online game, and she's excited to meet them in real life at a dessert café for the first time. The only problem: She's actually a man who's been lying to them. What begins as a tense manga about online life quickly turns into a lighthearted comedy about friendship, gender, and forgiving yourself and others.

(Source: Kodansha USA)

Note: Includes 4 extra chapters.

Yoshino is a struggling shoujo manga artist, with no hits to her name. When she goes to the publisher's office to meet her new editor, she meets Izumi, a former performer that she had a crush on...? This is a dreamy, slightly sexy, and exciting workplace love story of between a desperate shoujo mangaka and her celebrity editor!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

"I wonder what it'd be like to have your thick juicy lips working on me? If you were to lick, nibble, and tease me..."

Kou is the number one actor in the gay adult video industry, and he has a secret longing for his cameraman, Shuzo, who's like a partner to him. Kou's gay and Shuzo's straight. That is a huge frustrating barrier for Kou and his feelings for Shuzo keep welling up inside him. This eventually leads Kou to fantasize about Shuzo as he's being filmed through Shuzo's camera...

This is the long-awaited compilation of the series that received a ton of rave reviews for its beautiful artwork and touching story!!

The manga is about ten-year-old Chie, "the most unfortunate girl in Japan," who manages her family diner while her unemployed yakuza father and her mother are separated.

127969.description: A two volume side story to Ns' Aoi which features the earlier life of Misora Aoi. After Aoi's mother died, she eventually lost custody of her little brother to her estranged father. All alone, Aoi moved from her home in the country to a dorm in Tokyo to attend nursing school. She's going to have a lot of her plate, dealing with the classes, roommate issues, and everything else.

127970.description:
The manga takes place immediately after the end of episode five of the anime series, and tells another story not told in the anime. The manga follows high school students whose lives are completely changed after the arrival of the Kado cube and the unlimited energy source Wam.

127973.description:
The student council of Kokuun High, one of the most prestigious schools in the country, is made up entirely of elite students from families with storied pedigrees. But for some reason, Kousuke Tamanaka, an ordinary student whose only good point is monstrous strength, was chosen to be a new member of the student council! And he was also directly nominated by Junichi Tennomiya... to be his personal bodyguard?!

(Source: Gentosha Comics, translated)

127983.description: Woken up from a date, he’s suddenly in a movie set? Wait, he’s been reborn as a baby martial artist! In the Jongnam Clan, which was once one of the 9 strongest clans, he receives the name “Gun-Chung” and uses the knowledge of his past life to learn the true meaning of martial arts. When your perspective is different, your martial arts changes. Armed with knowledge, Gun-Chung brings about a new age of martial arts!

127993.description:
When the xenoterran invasion began, the only ones who stood between us and the monstrous creatures were the superhumans. But while some chose to use this power for good, others had more sinister intentions. Kang Lim is a high school student with a secret - he's the vigilante superhero known as the White Cap, fighting back the mysterious monsters whenever he can. But the world he protects isn't what it seems -- there is more to the emergence of the xenoterran than meets the eye, and strange forces are at play in the shadows.

(Source: WEBTOON)

With such ability, Raust has trained himself to contribute even just a little to his small group of first-class party. However, Raust’s sentiment bore no fruit. In an outburst of anger because of the failed quest, the party informed him of his expulsion. However, the party members realized something little by little once Raust left the party. Raust’s ability who was training himself had put him in the realm of the top class among adventurers. It was because Raust was in their party that the party was called first-class.
